"""Original raw6 target reference controller for ROOT's NEW zero-PT PhysX case.

Pure scalar source. No SDK, model, force, reset, state or command-publisher API.
All body motion/contact/limits/qualification are produced by the original plant.
This is an unvalidated parameterized teacher CANDIDATE, never a success oracle.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass
import math

ACTION_ORDER=('left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip','left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin')
FLIGHT_PHASES={'FLIGHT_TUCK','AIR_EXTEND'}
GROUND_PHASES={'SETTLE','BACKOFF','BRAKE_BACKOFF','ACCELERATE','CROUCH','CROUCH_COAST','PUSH','PUSH_HOLD','LAND_ABSORB','STABILIZE','SUCCESS_HOLD','ABORT_BRAKE'}


def smooth(x):
    x=max(0.,min(1.,x));return x*x*(3.-2.*x)


def blend(a,b,u):return tuple((1-u)*x+u*y for x,y in zip(a,b))


def wheel_forward_gains_from_own_fk(C,G,names,q):
    """Pure own FK at task yaw0: vX=-[omega_axis cross r_contact]_X.

    This determines signs/mesh no-slip conversion, not measured slip or speed.
    Contract joint-frame quaternions are wxyz; no SDK xyzw ambiguity is used.
    """
    mm=lambda A,B:[[sum(A[i][k]*B[k][j] for k in range(3)) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
    mv=lambda A,x:[sum(A[i][k]*x[k] for k in range(3)) for i in range(3)]
    tr=lambda A:list(map(list,zip(*A)))
    def rotation(q):
        z=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in q));w,x,y,z0=(v/z for v in q)
        return [[1-2*(y*y+z0*z0),2*(x*y-w*z0),2*(x*z0+w*y)],
            [2*(x*y+w*z0),1-2*(x*x+z0*z0),2*(y*z0-w*x)],
            [2*(x*z0-w*y),2*(y*z0+w*x),1-2*(x*x+y*y)]]
    bychild={row['child']:(name,row) for name,row in C['joints'].items()};values=dict(zip(names,map(float,q)))
    poses={'chassis':([0.,0.,0.],[[1.,0.,0.],[0.,1.,0.],[0.,0.,1.]])}
    def pose(body):
        if body in poses:return poses[body]
        name,row=bychild[body];pp,PR=pose(row['parent']);a=values[name]
        A=mm(PR,rotation(row['local_rot0']));axis=[x[0] for x in A]
        if row['type']=='hinge':motion=[[1.,0.,0.],[0.,math.cos(a),-math.sin(a)],[0.,math.sin(a),math.cos(a)]]
        else:motion=[[1.,0.,0.],[0.,1.,0.],[0.,0.,1.]]
        R=mm(mm(A,motion),tr(rotation(row['local_rot1'])))
        anchor=mv(PR,row['local_pos0']);offset=mv(R,row['local_pos1'])
        p=[pp[i]+anchor[i]-offset[i]+(axis[i]*a if row['type']=='slide' else 0.) for i in range(3)]
        poses[body]=(p,R);return p,R
    proof=[];gains=[]
    for joint in ('left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'):
        row=C['joints'][joint];parent_p,parent_R=pose(row['parent']);wp,WR=pose(row['child'])
        A=mm(parent_R,rotation(row['local_rot0']));axis=[x[0] for x in A]
        anchor=mv(parent_R,row['local_pos0']);anchor=[parent_p[i]+anchor[i] for i in range(3)]
        shape=next(h for h in G['shapes'] if h['body']==row['child']);assert shape['type']=='Mesh'
        vertices=[]
        for point in shape['points']:
            point=mv(shape['linear_body_from_shape'],point)
            point=[point[i]+shape['origin_body_m'][i] for i in range(3)];point=mv(WR,point)
            vertices.append([wp[i]+point[i] for i in range(3)])
        zmin=min(x[2] for x in vertices);ties=[x for x in vertices if abs(x[2]-zmin)<=1e-12]
        contact=[sum(x[i] for x in ties)/len(ties) for i in range(3)];r=[contact[i]-anchor[i] for i in range(3)]
        gain=-(axis[1]*r[2]-axis[2]*r[1]);assert abs(gain)>1e-5
        gains.append(gain);proof.append(dict(joint=joint,axis_world3=axis,r_contact_from_joint3=r,
            positive_joint_rad_s1_world_vx_no_slip=gain,negative_joint_rad_s1_world_vx_no_slip=-gain,
            quaternion_convention='imported_joint_frames_wxyz',scope='OWN_FK_YAW0_NO_SLIP_KINEMATICS_NOT_MEASURED_SLIP'))
    return tuple(gains),proof


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TeacherParameters:
    q_stand4:tuple
    q_crouch4:tuple
    q_air_tuck4:tuple
    q_land4:tuple
    push_tau_crouch4:tuple
    push_tau_extend4:tuple
    teacher_vx:float=1.1886541123
    acceleration_s:float=.5720755878
    crouch_s:float=.18
    push_s:float=.09
    extra_push_hold_s:float=.08
    settle_pose_s:float=.50
    tuck_s:float=.08
    air_extend_s:float=.10
    landing_absorb_s:float=.15
    recovery_rise_s:float=.40
    launch_front_m:float=.10
    runway_margin_m:float=.06
    backoff_speed_m_s:float=.5
    brake_hold_s:float=.20
    wheel_radius_m:float=.0625
    wheel_forward_gain2_m:tuple=(.0625,.0625)
    track_m:float=.4376
    wheel_pitch_gain:float=10.2
    wheel_pitch_rate_gain:float=1.32
    speed_error_gain:float=1.48
    yaw_gain:float=2.
    yaw_rate_gain:float=.5
    lateral_gain:float=.5
    roll_leg_gain:float=.15
    roll_leg_rate_gain:float=.03
    leg_scale:float=.5
    wheel_scale:float=10.
    leg_nominal_kp:float=60.
    original_command_vx:float=.5
    diff_min:float=-1.0843
    diff_max:float=.85
    minimum_bottom_before_air_extend_m:float=.28

    def __post_init__(self):
        for name in ('q_stand4','q_crouch4','q_air_tuck4','q_land4','push_tau_crouch4','push_tau_extend4'):
            values=tuple(float(x) for x in getattr(self,name));assert len(values)==4 and all(math.isfinite(x) for x in values),name
            object.__setattr__(self,name,values)
        assert max(map(abs,self.push_tau_crouch4+self.push_tau_extend4))<=40.000001
        assert 0<self.teacher_vx<3.4603067818 and self.wheel_radius_m==.0625
        assert self.leg_scale==.5 and self.wheel_scale==10. and self.leg_nominal_kp==60.
        gains=tuple(float(x) for x in self.wheel_forward_gain2_m);assert len(gains)==2 and all(abs(x)>1e-5 for x in gains)
        object.__setattr__(self,'wheel_forward_gain2_m',gains)
        assert all(x>0 for x in (self.acceleration_s,self.crouch_s,self.push_s,self.tuck_s,self.air_extend_s,self.settle_pose_s))

    @property
    def runway_start_front_m(self):
        # Includes ground crouch + push distance; the kinematic seed's-.20
        # acceleration-only runway is not silently reused as a real reset.
        distance=self.teacher_vx*(.5*self.acceleration_s+self.crouch_s+self.push_s)+self.runway_margin_m
        return self.launch_front_m-distance


def validate_observation(o):
    scalar=('root_pitch','root_roll','root_yaw','root_y','actual_command_vx')
    arrays={'world_velocity3':3,'world_angular_velocity3':3,'wheel_front2':2,'wheel_bottom2':2,'wheel_N2':2}
    for k in scalar:
        if k not in o or not math.isfinite(float(o[k])):raise ValueError('Missing/nonfinite actual observation: '+k)
    for k,n in arrays.items():
        if k not in o or len(o[k])!=n or not all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in o[k]):raise ValueError('Bad actual observation: '+k)
    for k in ('episode_id','global_control','public_age'):
        if k not in o or isinstance(o[k],bool) or not isinstance(o[k],int):raise ValueError('Integer original identity required: '+k)
    for k in ('request_active','clean_air_now','full_footprint','original_success','original_done'):
        if k not in o or type(o[k]) is not bool:raise ValueError('Actual bool or explicit missing-input failure required: '+k)
    for k in ('process_ready','qualified'):
        if k not in o or (o[k] is not None and type(o[k]) is not bool):raise ValueError('Actual bool or explicit UNKNOWN None required: '+k)
    for k in ('top_support_cue2','crossed2'):
        if k not in o or len(o[k])!=2 or any(type(x) is not bool for x in o[k]):raise ValueError('Actual bool2 required: '+k)
    if o['clean_air_now'] and (min(o['wheel_bottom2'])<=.005 or max(o['wheel_N2'])>1.000001):
        raise ValueError('Incoherent original clean-air/current force/bottom inputs; do not fabricate flight')
    if not 0<=o['global_control']<2000:raise ValueError('Original global2000-control cap')
    if 'actual_joint_q4' in o and (len(o['actual_joint_q4'])!=4 or not all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in o['actual_joint_q4'])):
        raise ValueError('Bad optional actual named leg positions')


class OwnMOD4TeacherReference:
    def __init__(self,parameters):
        self.p=parameters;self.episode=None;self.phase='UNINITIALIZED';self.started=0.
        self.last_leg=parameters.q_stand4;self.start_leg=self.last_leg
        self.had_air=False;self.air_start=None;self.flight_id=0;self.last_air=False
        self.brake_stopped_since=None;self.failure_reason=None;self.last_global_control=None

    def _set(self,phase,t):
        if phase!=self.phase:
            self.phase=phase;self.started=t;self.start_leg=self.last_leg

    def bootstrap(self,q30,joint_names,global_control=0):
        """One first action from actual initialized q; contact is UNKNOWN.

        ROOT must never fabricate zero force before the first physical cache.
        This holds actual leg targets and requests zero wheel velocity only.
        """
        if self.last_global_control is not None or global_control!=0:raise ValueError('Bootstrap is only the first action of a NEW case')
        if len(q30)!=30 or len(joint_names)!=30:raise ValueError('Actual named30 initialization required')
        q=[float(q30[joint_names.index(name)]) for name in ACTION_ORDER[:4]]
        if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in q):raise ValueError('Nonfinite actual initial q')
        for i in (0,2):q[i]=min(q[i+1]+self.p.diff_max,max(q[i+1]+self.p.diff_min,q[i]))
        raw=tuple(max(-6.,min(6.,x/self.p.leg_scale)) for x in q)+(0.,0.)
        self.last_global_control=0;self.last_leg=tuple(q);self.start_leg=self.last_leg
        return dict(raw6=raw,phase='BOOTSTRAP_CONTACT_UNKNOWN',force_and_contact='UNKNOWN_NO_PHYSICAL_CALLBACK_YET',
            original_success='UNKNOWN',physical_teacher_valid=False,no_state_force_reset_or_goal_write=True)

    def step(self,o):
        validate_observation(o)
        p=self.p;t=.01*o['global_control'];air=o['clean_air_now']
        if self.last_global_control is not None and o['global_control']<=self.last_global_control:
            raise ValueError('Replayed/reversed control; new purpose/episode must not reuse consumed controls')
        if self.episode!=o['episode_id']:
            self.episode=o['episode_id'];self.phase='SETTLE';self.started=t
            self.start_leg=tuple(o.get('actual_joint_q4',self.last_leg));self.last_leg=self.start_leg
            self.had_air=False;self.air_start=None;self.last_air=False;self.brake_stopped_since=None;self.failure_reason=None
        self.last_global_control=o['global_control']
        if o['original_done']:
            self._set('TERMINATED',t)
        elif o['original_success']:
            self._set('SUCCESS_HOLD',t)
        elif not o['request_active']:
            self._set('SETTLE',t)
        elif air:
            if not self.last_air:
                self.flight_id+=1;self.had_air=True;self.air_start=t;self._set('FLIGHT_TUCK',t)
            descending=o['world_velocity3'][2]<0
            if self.phase=='FLIGHT_TUCK' and (t-self.started>=p.tuck_s) and descending:
                if all(o['crossed2']) or (min(o['wheel_front2'])>=.37 and min(o['wheel_bottom2'])>=p.minimum_bottom_before_air_extend_m):
                    self._set('AIR_EXTEND',t)
        elif self.had_air and self.last_air:
            if any(o['top_support_cue2']):self._set('LAND_ABSORB',t)
            else:self.failure_reason='real_contact_before_top_landing';self._set('ABORT_BRAKE',t)
        else:
            elapsed=t-self.started
            if self.phase=='SETTLE':self._set('BACKOFF' if max(o['wheel_front2'])>p.runway_start_front_m+.015 else 'BRAKE_BACKOFF',t)
            elif self.phase=='BACKOFF' and max(o['wheel_front2'])<=p.runway_start_front_m+.015:self._set('BRAKE_BACKOFF',t)
            elif self.phase=='BRAKE_BACKOFF':
                if abs(o['world_velocity3'][0])<.1:
                    if self.brake_stopped_since is None:self.brake_stopped_since=t
                    if t-self.brake_stopped_since>=p.brake_hold_s:self._set('ACCELERATE',t)
                else:self.brake_stopped_since=None
            elif self.phase=='ACCELERATE' and elapsed>=p.acceleration_s:self._set('CROUCH',t)
            elif self.phase=='CROUCH' and elapsed>=p.crouch_s:self._set('CROUCH_COAST',t)
            elif self.phase=='CROUCH_COAST' and max(o['wheel_front2'])>=p.launch_front_m-p.teacher_vx*p.push_s:self._set('PUSH',t)
            elif self.phase=='PUSH' and elapsed>=p.push_s:self._set('PUSH_HOLD',t)
            elif self.phase=='PUSH_HOLD' and elapsed>=p.extra_push_hold_s:
                self.failure_reason='no_true_both_wheel_takeoff';self._set('ABORT_BRAKE',t)
            elif self.phase=='LAND_ABSORB' and elapsed>=p.landing_absorb_s:self._set('STABILIZE',t)
        # Late grounded approach is a failed reference; braking never changes
        # original reset/termination/event counters or manufactures clearance.
        if self.phase in {'ACCELERATE','CROUCH','CROUCH_COAST','PUSH','PUSH_HOLD'}:
            if max(o['wheel_front2'])>=.31 and min(o['wheel_bottom2'])<.27 and not air:
                self.failure_reason='late_grounded_approach_before_riser';self._set('ABORT_BRAKE',t)
        elapsed=t-self.started;zero=(0.,)*4;ff=zero;desired_vx=0.
        if self.phase=='SETTLE':leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_stand4,smooth(elapsed/p.settle_pose_s))
        elif self.phase=='BACKOFF':
            distance=max(o['wheel_front2'])-p.runway_start_front_m
            desired_vx=-min(p.backoff_speed_m_s,max(.10,1.5*distance));leg=p.q_stand4
        elif self.phase=='ACCELERATE':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx*smooth(elapsed/p.acceleration_s);leg=p.q_stand4
        elif self.phase=='CROUCH':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_crouch4,smooth(elapsed/p.crouch_s))
        elif self.phase=='CROUCH_COAST':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=p.q_crouch4
        elif self.phase in {'PUSH','PUSH_HOLD'}:
            u=smooth(elapsed/p.push_s) if self.phase=='PUSH' else 1.
            desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=blend(p.q_crouch4,p.q_stand4,u);ff=blend(p.push_tau_crouch4,p.push_tau_extend4,u)
        elif self.phase=='FLIGHT_TUCK':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_air_tuck4,smooth(elapsed/p.tuck_s))
        elif self.phase=='AIR_EXTEND':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_stand4,smooth(elapsed/p.air_extend_s))
        elif self.phase=='LAND_ABSORB':leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_land4,smooth(elapsed/p.landing_absorb_s))
        elif self.phase=='STABILIZE':leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_stand4,smooth(elapsed/p.recovery_rise_s))
        else:leg=p.q_stand4
        self.last_leg=tuple(leg)
        command=[q+tau/p.leg_nominal_kp for q,tau in zip(leg,ff)]
        if self.phase in GROUND_PHASES:
            correction=p.roll_leg_gain*o['root_roll']+p.roll_leg_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][0]
            command=[q+d for q,d in zip(command,(correction,-correction,-correction,correction))]
        for i in (0,2):command[i]=min(command[i+1]+p.diff_max,max(command[i+1]+p.diff_min,command[i]))
        vx=o['world_velocity3'][0]
        # Ground wheel-balance seed: gains are engineering/controller values,
        # not physical forces or a promise of stability. In air this requests
        # wheel reaction/landing speed, never direct COM acceleration.
        omega=vx/p.wheel_radius_m+p.wheel_pitch_gain*o['root_pitch']+p.wheel_pitch_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][1]+p.speed_error_gain*(desired_vx-vx)
        yaw_rate=-p.yaw_gain*o['root_yaw']-p.yaw_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][2]-p.lateral_gain*o['root_y']
        differential=p.track_m/(2*p.wheel_radius_m)*yaw_rate
        unbounded=[q/p.leg_scale for q in command]+[p.wheel_radius_m*(omega-differential)/p.wheel_forward_gain2_m[0]/p.wheel_scale,
            p.wheel_radius_m*(omega+differential)/p.wheel_forward_gain2_m[1]/p.wheel_scale]
        raw=tuple(max(-6.,min(6.,x)) for x in unbounded)
        self.last_air=air
        return dict(raw6=raw,phase=self.phase,planned_leg_target4=tuple(command),nominal_push_feedforward_tau4=ff,
            requested_teacher_vx=desired_vx,actual_original_command_vx=o['actual_command_vx'],
            command_publisher_unchanged=True,runway_start_front_design_m=p.runway_start_front_m,
            runway_must_be_reached_by_actual_wheel_motion=True,flight_id=self.flight_id,
            observed_clean_air=air,observed_qualified=o['qualified'],observed_crossed2=tuple(o['crossed2']),
            observed_original_success=o['original_success'],observed_original_done=o['original_done'],
            original_success_only_source_of_success=True,failure_reason=self.failure_reason,
            top_support_cue_is_control_feedback_not_qualification=True,
            raw_saturation6=tuple(abs(a-b)>1e-12 for a,b in zip(unbounded,raw)),
            process_ready_observed_not_overridden=o['process_ready'],
            feedforward_is_nominal_not_actual_motor_torque=True,
            physical_teacher_valid=False,no_state_force_reset_or_goal_write=True)


def parameters_from_own_seed(import_contract,projected_seed,bounded_lp,own_geometry):
    names=projected_seed['joint_names'];indices=[names.index(n) for n in ACTION_ORDER[:4]]
    q=projected_seed['q30_reference_only'];stand=tuple(float(q[0][j]) for j in indices);tuck=tuple(float(q[4][j]) for j in indices)
    rows={row['pose']:row for row in bounded_lp['rows']}
    ext_tau=tuple(rows['extension']['tau6_Nm'][:4]);tuck_tau=tuple(rows['tuck']['tau6_Nm'][:4])
    mass=sum(b['mass_kg'] for b in import_contract['bodies'].values());radius=import_contract['wheel_motor']['wheel_radius_m']
    h=projected_seed['seed_pose_diagnostics']['extension']['COM_floor_reference_z_m']-radius
    wheel_acceleration_gain=2*.6/(mass*radius);frequency=4.;damping_ratio=.9
    forward_gain,proof=wheel_forward_gains_from_own_fk(import_contract,own_geometry,names,q[0])
    values=dict(q_stand4=stand,q_crouch4=tuck,q_air_tuck4=tuck,q_land4=blend(stand,tuck,.35),
        push_tau_crouch4=tuck_tau,push_tau_extend4=ext_tau,
        teacher_vx=float(projected_seed['variables']['vx_m_s']),acceleration_s=float(projected_seed['variables']['acceleration_s']),
        wheel_radius_m=radius,wheel_forward_gain2_m=forward_gain,wheel_pitch_gain=(9.81+h*frequency**2)/wheel_acceleration_gain,
        wheel_pitch_rate_gain=2*damping_ratio*frequency*h/wheel_acceleration_gain,speed_error_gain=2/wheel_acceleration_gain)
    return TeacherParameters(**values)


def observation_from_existing_callback(cache,meta):
    """ROOT's unbatched N1 original-phase cache -> scalar source inputs.

    cache: kw/result/last_measured from ONE original physical(**kw) call;
    meta: original next-action clock/done, existing root buffer and origin.
    No contact query, state extrapolation, model, RNG or source-env mutation.
    The top cue is explicitly an engineering controller cue, not a claim that
    original top12/stable200 or same-flight qualification has been attained.
    """
    if cache is None:raise ValueError('Initial callback measurements UNKNOWN; use bootstrap(actual q30) once')
    kw=cache['kw'];result=cache['result'];last=cache['last_measured'];origin=meta['env_origin3_world']
    low=last['step_wheel_min'];high=last['step_wheel_max'];forces=tuple(float(x) for x in kw['wheel_N'])
    bottom=tuple(float(x[2]-origin[2]) for x in low);front=tuple(float(x[0]-origin[0]) for x in high)
    top_face=last['step_platform_contact']
    top_cue=tuple(bool(top_face[i]) and forces[i]>1. and bottom[i]>=.269 for i in (0,1))
    root=meta['root_xyz_world'];world_v=meta['root_vxyz_world'];world_w=meta['root_omega_xyz_world']
    o=dict(episode_id=int(meta['episode_id']),global_control=int(meta['global_control']),
        public_age=int(meta['public_age_for_action']),request_active=meta['request_active_for_action'],
        process_ready=meta.get('process_ready',None),qualified=meta.get('reward126_qualified',None),
        root_pitch=float(kw['pitch']),root_roll=float(kw['roll']),root_yaw=float(kw['yaw']),
        root_y=float(root[1]-origin[1]),world_velocity3=tuple(float(x) for x in world_v),
        world_angular_velocity3=tuple(float(x) for x in world_w),wheel_front2=front,wheel_bottom2=bottom,wheel_N2=forces,
        clean_air_now=result['air'],top_support_cue2=top_cue,
        full_footprint=all(last['step_footprint_inside']),crossed2=tuple(bool(x) for x in last['step_first_cross_clear']),
        original_success=last['step_goal_success'],original_done=meta['original_done'],
        actual_command_vx=float(meta['actual_command_vx']),
        original_stable_callbacks=last['step_stable_ticks'],prepared_now=result['prepared'],
        top_cue_source='cached_query_top_ID_and_existing_force_gt1_and_bottom_ge269mm_CONTROL_CUE_ONLY')
    if 'q30' in meta and 'joint_names' in meta:
        o['actual_joint_q4']=tuple(float(meta['q30'][meta['joint_names'].index(n)]) for n in ACTION_ORDER[:4])
    validate_observation(o);return o

        old_np=np.load;allowed={str((B/x['relative']).resolve()):x for x in t['necessary_original_NPZ_admission']}
        def tracked_npz(file,*aa,**kk):

                path=str(Path(file).resolve());require(path in allowed,'undeclared NPZ read')

                npz_reads.append(dict(path=path,producer_SHA=allowed[path]['SHA'],bytes=allowed[path]['bytes'],load_calls=1,purpose='Necessary original environment/reset construction only'))
            return old_np(file,*aa,**kk)
        np.load=tracked_npz;restore_hooks.append(lambda:setattr(np,'load',old_np))

        from native88C_to_flat_migration_v1 import observe_first_original_preload_write

        require(env.num_envs==1 and env.physics_dt==.0025 and env.step_dt==.01 and env.cfg.decimation==4 and env._sim_step_counter==0,'actual fresh N1 original clocks')

        require(props.solver_position_iteration_count==32 and props.solver_velocity_iteration_count==4 and env.cfg.sim.physics.solver_type==1,'original TGS32/4')

        require(env._physics_action_delay.queue.control_us==10000 and env._rescue_reset_bank[0].shape==(74,30),'original queue/reset population')
        command=install_fudan_step_request_and_command(env);process=install_process(env)
        require(command['request_control_interval']==[200,2000],'original public request domain')
        gas=check_actual_new_gas(env,expected_joint_names=names,tensor=tensor,require_active_preload=False)
        bank=check_runtime_source(J/'runtime/isaac/mod4');preload=SimpleNamespace(preload_evidence=None)
        observe_first_original_preload_write(env,preload,expected_joint_names=names,emit=lambda v:put(out,'ORIGINAL_PRELOAD_BEFORE_WRITE_ACTUAL.json',v))
        manager_source=Path(inspect.getsourcefile(type(env.termination_manager)))
        require(H(manager_source)=='cb6333f11fa6472f7d8034bae9835714e83ae3edde97894b767f1351a7eea99d','actual cached original TerminationManager API')
        from teacher140_controller_adapter_v1 import build_controller,observation_from_cache
        controller=build_controller(read(root/'TEACHER_PARAMETERS.json'))
        put(out,'ACTUAL_SOURCE_SDK_OWN_MODEL_AND_PRECONTROL_ADMISSION.json',dict(passed=True,source_manifest_SHA=checked['manifest_SHA'],versions=versions,actual_joint_names=names,actual_body_names=robot.body_names,gas=gas,bank=bank,command=command,process=process,neural_checkpoint_reads=len(model_read_attempts),necessary_NPZ_reads=npz_reads,initial_is_original_ground_reset=True,no_force_state_or_physics_edit=True))
        put(out,'ACTUAL_RENDER_GEOMETRY.json',dict(body_names=list(robot.body_names),shapes=env.h1_shapes,geometry=terrain.GEOMETRY))
        fs=ProducerStream(out/'TEACHER_ACTUAL_400HZ_CACHED_CALLBACKS.jsonl','actual_original_PhysX_cached_callback','one original episode, no extra sensor getter')

        streams=[fs,cs];observer=OriginalCachedPhaseObserver(env,fs);observer.install();small=[];start=time.monotonic();controls=0;ending='unknown'
        with torch.inference_mode():

                cached=observer.last if observer.last is not None else initial

                _,reward,done,extras=vec.step(torch.tensor([raw],device=env.device,dtype=torch.float32))
                require(observer.callbacks-before==4 and observer.terminal is not None,'four original callbacks plus one cached termination')
                terminal=observer.terminal;controls=control+1
                cs.write(dict(schema='mod4.teacher140.control.v1',control=control,teacher=decision,terminal=terminal,original_physical_reward=reward,actual_done=bool(done[0])))
                last=plain(terminal['state'])
                small.append(dict(control=control,phase=decision['phase'],root13_sdk_xyzw=last['root13_sdk_xyzw'],wheel_low_world=last.get('wheel_low_world'),wheel_high_world=last.get('wheel_high_world'),physical_arguments=last.get('physical_arguments'),original_goal=last['original_goal'],raw6=raw))
                if bool(done[0]):ending='original_done';break
            else:ending='original_twenty_second_cap'
        require(preload.preload_evidence is not None,'original real first preload was observed')
        observer.restore()
        for stream in streams:producers.append(stream.close())
        streams=[]
        put(out,'TYPED_JSONL_PRODUCER_PATH_BYTES_SHA_INDEX.json',dict(artifacts=producers,no_content_reread=True))
        put(out,'SMALL_TRAJECTORY_FOR_MATLAB_PARAMETER_FIT_ACTUAL.json',dict(schema='mod4.teacher140.small_actual_trajectory_fit.v1',purpose='New actual teacher-control parameter fit only, no old raw/model read',rows=small,controls=controls,physics_dt_s=.0025,control_dt_s=.01))

    except BaseException:
        put(out,'ORIGINAL_TEACHER_EVALUATOR_ERROR_ACTUAL.json',dict(epoch=time.time(),traceback=traceback.format_exc(),model_read_attempts=model_read_attempts,necessary_NPZ_reads=npz_reads,actual_callbacks=None if observer is None else observer.callbacks,physical_success_not_inferred=True));raise
    finally:
        if observer is not None:observer.restore()
        for stream in streams:
            if not stream.file.closed:producers.append(stream.close())
        if producers and not (out/'TYPED_JSONL_PRODUCER_PATH_BYTES_SHA_INDEX.json').exists():put(out,'TYPED_JSONL_PRODUCER_PATH_BYTES_SHA_INDEX.json',dict(artifacts=producers,partial=True,no_content_reread=True))
        for restore in reversed(restore_hooks):restore()
        if env is not None:
            try:env.close()
            except BaseException:put(out,'ORIGINAL_ENV_CLOSE_ERROR_ACTUAL.json',dict(traceback=traceback.format_exc()))
        for handle in reversed(handles):handle.close()
        if app is not None:app.close()

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Pure translation of the existing original callback cache to frozen teacher."""
from own_mod4_teacher_raw6_reference_v1 import TeacherParameters,OwnMOD4TeacherReference,observation_from_existing_callback

class BoundController:
    def __init__(self,parameters):self.controller=OwnMOD4TeacherReference(TeacherParameters(**parameters))
    def step(self,observation):
        if observation['kind']=='initial_contact_unknown':
            return self.controller.bootstrap(observation['q30'],observation['joint_names'],global_control=0)
        return self.controller.step(observation['source_observation'])

def build_controller(parameters):return BoundController(parameters)

def observation_from_cache(state,control):
    if not state['measurements_available']:
        if control!=0:raise ValueError('Missing physical callback after first action')
        return dict(kind='initial_contact_unknown',q30=list(state['q30']),joint_names=list(state['named_joint_order']))
    if state['next_age_control']!=control:raise ValueError('Next-action clock differs from actual public age')
    if 'actual_original_done' not in state:raise ValueError('Prior original termination result is unknown')
    root=state['root13_sdk_xyzw'];goal=state['original_goal']
    cache=dict(kw=state['physical_arguments'],result=state['original_physical_result'],last_measured=dict(
        step_wheel_min=state['wheel_low_world'],step_wheel_max=state['wheel_high_world'],
        step_platform_contact=state['actual_top_face'],step_footprint_inside=state['actual_full_footprint'],
        step_first_cross_clear=state['original_crossed2'],step_stable_ticks=goal['stable_ticks'],step_goal_success=goal['success']))
    meta=dict(episode_id=int(state['episode_id']),global_control=control,public_age_for_action=state['next_age_control'],
        request_active_for_action=state['next_request_active'],original_done=state['actual_original_done'],
        actual_command_vx=state['actual_command_vx_for_action'],env_origin3_world=state['env_origin3_world'],
        root_xyz_world=root[:3],root_vxyz_world=root[7:10],root_omega_xyz_world=root[10:13],
        process_ready=None,reward126_qualified=None,q30=state['q30'],joint_names=state['named_joint_order'])
    observation=observation_from_existing_callback(cache,meta)
    return dict(kind='original_cached_physical',source_observation=observation,
        physical_measurement_public_age=state['age_control'],next_action_public_age=control)

"""Observe the original physical callback once; no added contact/physics query."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,math,types
from teacher140_task_guard_v1 import require

def plain(value):
    if hasattr(value,'torch'):value=value.torch
    if hasattr(value,'detach'):return value.detach().cpu().tolist()
    if isinstance(value,dict):return {k:plain(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,(tuple,list)):return [plain(x) for x in value]
    if isinstance(value,float):require(math.isfinite(value),'nonfinite diagnostic value')
    return value

class ProducerStream:
    def __init__(self,path,kind,domain):
        self.path=Path(path);self.kind=kind;self.domain=domain;self.file=self.path.open('xb');self.rows=0;self.bytes=0;self.sha=hashlib.sha256()
    def write(self,value):
        b=(json.dumps(plain(value),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode('utf8')
        self.file.write(b);self.sha.update(b);self.bytes+=len(b);self.rows+=1
    def close(self):
        self.file.flush();self.file.close()
        require(self.path.stat().st_size==self.bytes,'producer byte count')
        return dict(path=str(self.path),bytes=self.bytes,SHA=self.sha.hexdigest(),rows=self.rows,kind=self.kind,domain=self.domain,producer_counted_in_single_write_pass=True,no_content_reread=True)

class OriginalCachedPhaseObserver:
    def __init__(self,env,stream):
        self.env=env;self.phase=env.h1_phase;self.stream=stream;self.callbacks=0;self.control_for_action=0
        self.last=None;self.terminal=None;self.terms_calls=0;self.installed=False
    def tensor(self,x):
        if hasattr(x,'torch'):return x.torch
        return x
    def state(self,kw=None,result=None):
        e=self.env;p=self.phase;r=e.scene['robot'];tensor=self.tensor
        root=tensor(r.data.root_state_w)[0].clone();q=tensor(r.data.joint_pos)[0].clone();dq=tensor(r.data.joint_vel)[0].clone()
        origin=e.scene.env_origins[0].clone();cache=p.last_measured
        measured=kw is not None and all(k in cache for k in ('step_wheel_min','step_wheel_max','step_platform_contact','step_footprint_inside'))
        row=dict(physics_callback=self.callbacks,control_for_action=self.control_for_action,physical_time_s=self.callbacks*.0025,
            age_control=int(p.age_control[0]),request_for_action=bool(p.request_for_action[0]),measurements_available=measured,
            root13_sdk_xyzw=root,q30=q,dq30=dq,env_origin3_world=origin,
            named_joint_order=list(r.joint_names),body_order=list(r.body_names),
            original_goal={k:tensor(getattr(p.goal,k))[0].clone() for k in ('success','stable_ticks','launched','landed','edge','attempt')},
            original_counts={k:int(getattr(p,k)[0]) for k in ('takeoff_count','landing_count','recovery_count')})
        if measured:
            row.update(physical_arguments={k:tensor(v)[0].clone() for k,v in kw.items()},
                original_physical_result={k:tensor(v)[0].clone() for k,v in result.items()},
                wheel_low_world=cache['step_wheel_min'][0].clone(),wheel_high_world=cache['step_wheel_max'][0].clone(),
                actual_top_face=cache['step_platform_contact'][0].clone(),actual_full_footprint=cache['step_footprint_inside'][0].clone(),
                original_crossed2=p.crossed[0].clone(),
                physical_applied_processed6=__import__('torch').cat([tensor(e._physics_action_delay.queue.groups[k]['applied']) for k in ('legs','wheels')],-1)[0].clone(),
                original_raw_action6=e.action_manager.action[0].clone(),
                body_position31=tensor(r.data.body_pos_w)[0].clone(),body_quaternion31_sdk_xyzw=tensor(r.data.body_quat_w)[0].clone())
        return row
    def install(self):
        require(not self.installed,'install once');self.old_physical=self.phase.physical;self.old_term=self.env.termination_manager.compute
        observer=self
        def physical(this,**kw):
            result=observer.old_physical(**kw)
            observer.callbacks+=1;require(observer.callbacks<=8000,'original callback maximum')
            observer.last=observer.state(kw,result)
            observer.stream.write(dict(schema='mod4.teacher140.cached_original_callback.v1',state=observer.last))
            return result
        def term(*args,**kwargs):
            value=observer.old_term(*args,**kwargs)
            if observer.env.h1_stepping:
                observer.terms_calls+=1;manager=observer.env.termination_manager
                names=manager._term_names;dones=observer.tensor(manager._term_dones)
                require(dones.shape==(1,len(names)),'cached termination matrix')
                observer.terminal=dict(state=observer.last,aggregate_done=observer.tensor(value).clone(),
                    original_terms={name:bool(dones[0,i]) for i,name in enumerate(names)},
                    original_compute_called_once=True,cached_terms_no_recompute=True)
            return value
        self.phase.physical=types.MethodType(physical,self.phase);self.env.termination_manager.compute=term;self.installed=True
        return dict(original_physical_single_call=True,original_result_returned_unchanged=True,no_extra_contact_getter=True,no_reset_RNG_or_guard_change=True)
    def restore(self):
        if self.installed:
            self.phase.physical=self.old_physical;self.env.termination_manager.compute=self.old_term;self.installed=False

                    original_compute_called_once=True,cached_terms_no_recompute=True)
            return value

def fresh_local(mode):
    command=r"Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='python.exe' OR Name='ssh.exe'\" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'run_teacher140_secure|collect_TWO134|collect_E3_source210_TERMINAL' } | Select-Object Name,ProcessId,CreationDate,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress"
    # The actual PowerShell argument contains quotes, not shell interpolation.
    command=command.replace('\\"','"')
    q=subprocess.run(['pwsh.exe','-NoProfile','-Command',command],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf8',check=True)
    rows=json.loads(q.stdout) if q.stdout.strip() else [];rows=rows if isinstance(rows,list) else [rows]
    active=[x for x in rows if x['ProcessId']!=os.getpid()]
    report=dict(epoch=time.time(),mode=mode,self_PID=os.getpid(),self_executable=sys.executable,self_argv=sys.argv,matched_known_own_finite_identities=rows,other_matching_own_finites=active)
    put('FRESH_LOCAL_EXACT_CIM_'+mode.upper()+'_ACTUAL.json',report)
    assert not active,'another known own finite is alive; do not open a second SSH channel'
    return report

def fresh_local(mode):
    command="""Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='python.exe' OR Name='ssh.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'run_teacher140_secure|collect_TWO134|collect_E3_source210_TERMINAL' } | Select-Object Name,ProcessId,CreationDate,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress"""
    q=subprocess.run(['pwsh.exe','-NoProfile','-Command',command],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf8',check=True)
    rows=json.loads(q.stdout) if q.stdout.strip() else [];rows=rows if isinstance(rows,list) else [rows]
    active=[x for x in rows if x['ProcessId']!=os.getpid()]
    report=dict(epoch=time.time(),mode=mode,self_PID=os.getpid(),self_executable=sys.executable,self_argv=sys.argv,matched_known_own_finite_identities=rows,other_matching_own_finites=active)
    put('FRESH_LOCAL_EXACT_CIM_'+mode.upper()+'_ACTUAL.json',report)
    assert not active,'another known own finite is alive; do not open a second SSH channel'
    return report

        assert phase.calls==8 and manager.calls==2 and observer.callbacks==8 and stream.rows==8
        assert observer.last['measurements_available'] and observer.terminal['original_terms']==dict(time_out=False,closure=False)
        report['groups'].append(dict(name='eight_original_callbacks_two_cached_termination_calls',passed=True,original_physical_calls=phase.calls,original_termination_calls=manager.calls))
        observer.restore();assert phase.physical==old_physical and manager.compute==old_term

        assert torch.equal(rng,torch.random.get_rng_state()) and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()

GROUND_PHASES={'SETTLE','BACKOFF','BRAKE_BACKOFF','ACCELERATE','CROUCH','CROUCH_COAST','PUSH','PUSH_HOLD','LAND_ABSORB','STABILIZE','SUCCESS_HOLD','ABORT_BRAKE'}


def smooth(x):
    x=max(0.,min(1.,x));return x*x*(3.-2.*x)


def blend(a,b,u):return tuple((1-u)*x+u*y for x,y in zip(a,b))


def wheel_forward_gains_from_own_fk(C,G,names,q):
    """Pure own FK at task yaw0: vX=-[omega_axis cross r_contact]_X.

    This determines signs/mesh no-slip conversion, not measured slip or speed.
    Contract joint-frame quaternions are wxyz; no SDK xyzw ambiguity is used.
    """
    mm=lambda A,B:[[sum(A[i][k]*B[k][j] for k in range(3)) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
    mv=lambda A,x:[sum(A[i][k]*x[k] for k in range(3)) for i in range(3)]
    tr=lambda A:list(map(list,zip(*A)))
    def rotation(q):
        z=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in q));w,x,y,z0=(v/z for v in q)
        return [[1-2*(y*y+z0*z0),2*(x*y-w*z0),2*(x*z0+w*y)],
            [2*(x*y+w*z0),1-2*(x*x+z0*z0),2*(y*z0-w*x)],
            [2*(x*z0-w*y),2*(y*z0+w*x),1-2*(x*x+y*y)]]
    bychild={row['child']:(name,row) for name,row in C['joints'].items()};values=dict(zip(names,map(float,q)))
    poses={'chassis':([0.,0.,0.],[[1.,0.,0.],[0.,1.,0.],[0.,0.,1.]])}
    def pose(body):
        if body in poses:return poses[body]
        name,row=bychild[body];pp,PR=pose(row['parent']);a=values[name]
        A=mm(PR,rotation(row['local_rot0']));axis=[x[0] for x in A]
        if row['type']=='hinge':motion=[[1.,0.,0.],[0.,math.cos(a),-math.sin(a)],[0.,math.sin(a),math.cos(a)]]
        else:motion=[[1.,0.,0.],[0.,1.,0.],[0.,0.,1.]]
        R=mm(mm(A,motion),tr(rotation(row['local_rot1'])))
        anchor=mv(PR,row['local_pos0']);offset=mv(R,row['local_pos1'])
        p=[pp[i]+anchor[i]-offset[i]+(axis[i]*a if row['type']=='slide' else 0.) for i in range(3)]
        poses[body]=(p,R);return p,R
    proof=[];gains=[]
    for joint in ('left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'):
        row=C['joints'][joint];parent_p,parent_R=pose(row['parent']);wp,WR=pose(row['child'])
        A=mm(parent_R,rotation(row['local_rot0']));axis=[x[0] for x in A]
        anchor=mv(parent_R,row['local_pos0']);anchor=[parent_p[i]+anchor[i] for i in range(3)]
        shape=next(h for h in G['shapes'] if h['body']==row['child']);assert shape['type']=='Mesh'
        vertices=[]
        for point in shape['points']:
            point=mv(shape['linear_body_from_shape'],point)
            point=[point[i]+shape['origin_body_m'][i] for i in range(3)];point=mv(WR,point)
            vertices.append([wp[i]+point[i] for i in range(3)])
        zmin=min(x[2] for x in vertices);ties=[x for x in vertices if abs(x[2]-zmin)<=1e-12]
        contact=[sum(x[i] for x in ties)/len(ties) for i in range(3)];r=[contact[i]-anchor[i] for i in range(3)]
        gain=-(axis[1]*r[2]-axis[2]*r[1]);assert abs(gain)>1e-5
        gains.append(gain);proof.append(dict(joint=joint,axis_world3=axis,r_contact_from_joint3=r,
            positive_joint_rad_s1_world_vx_no_slip=gain,negative_joint_rad_s1_world_vx_no_slip=-gain,
            quaternion_convention='imported_joint_frames_wxyz',scope='OWN_FK_YAW0_NO_SLIP_KINEMATICS_NOT_MEASURED_SLIP'))
    return tuple(gains),proof


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TeacherParameters:
    q_stand4:tuple
    q_crouch4:tuple
    q_air_tuck4:tuple
    q_land4:tuple
    push_tau_crouch4:tuple
    push_tau_extend4:tuple
    teacher_vx:float=1.1886541123
    acceleration_s:float=.5720755878
    crouch_s:float=.18
    push_s:float=.09
    extra_push_hold_s:float=.08
    settle_pose_s:float=.50
    tuck_s:float=.08
    air_extend_s:float=.10
    landing_absorb_s:float=.15
    recovery_rise_s:float=.40
    launch_front_m:float=.10
    runway_margin_m:float=.06
    backoff_speed_m_s:float=.5
    brake_hold_s:float=.20
    wheel_radius_m:float=.0625
    wheel_forward_gain2_m:tuple=(.0625,.0625)
    track_m:float=.4376
    wheel_pitch_gain:float=10.2
    wheel_pitch_rate_gain:float=1.32
    speed_error_gain:float=1.48
    yaw_gain:float=2.
    yaw_rate_gain:float=.5
    lateral_gain:float=.5
    roll_leg_gain:float=.15
    roll_leg_rate_gain:float=.03
    leg_scale:float=.5
    wheel_scale:float=10.
    leg_nominal_kp:float=60.
    original_command_vx:float=.5
    diff_min:float=-1.0843
    diff_max:float=.85
    minimum_bottom_before_air_extend_m:float=.28

    def __post_init__(self):
        for name in ('q_stand4','q_crouch4','q_air_tuck4','q_land4','push_tau_crouch4','push_tau_extend4'):
            values=tuple(float(x) for x in getattr(self,name));assert len(values)==4 and all(math.isfinite(x) for x in values),name
            object.__setattr__(self,name,values)
        assert max(map(abs,self.push_tau_crouch4+self.push_tau_extend4))<=40.000001
        assert 0<self.teacher_vx<3.4603067818 and self.wheel_radius_m==.0625
        assert self.leg_scale==.5 and self.wheel_scale==10. and self.leg_nominal_kp==60.
        gains=tuple(float(x) for x in self.wheel_forward_gain2_m);assert len(gains)==2 and all(abs(x)>1e-5 for x in gains)
        object.__setattr__(self,'wheel_forward_gain2_m',gains)
        assert all(x>0 for x in (self.acceleration_s,self.crouch_s,self.push_s,self.tuck_s,self.air_extend_s,self.settle_pose_s))

    @property
    def runway_start_front_m(self):
        # Includes ground crouch + push distance; the kinematic seed's-.20
        # acceleration-only runway is not silently reused as a real reset.
        distance=self.teacher_vx*(.5*self.acceleration_s+self.crouch_s+self.push_s)+self.runway_margin_m
        return self.launch_front_m-distance


def validate_observation(o):
    scalar=('root_pitch','root_roll','root_yaw','root_y','actual_command_vx')
    arrays={'world_velocity3':3,'world_angular_velocity3':3,'wheel_front2':2,'wheel_bottom2':2,'wheel_N2':2}
    for k in scalar:
        if k not in o or not math.isfinite(float(o[k])):raise ValueError('Missing/nonfinite actual observation: '+k)
    for k,n in arrays.items():
        if k not in o or len(o[k])!=n or not all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in o[k]):raise ValueError('Bad actual observation: '+k)
    for k in ('episode_id','global_control','public_age'):
        if k not in o or isinstance(o[k],bool) or not isinstance(o[k],int):raise ValueError('Integer original identity required: '+k)
    for k in ('request_active','clean_air_now','full_footprint','original_success','original_done'):
        if k not in o or type(o[k]) is not bool:raise ValueError('Actual bool or explicit missing-input failure required: '+k)
    for k in ('process_ready','qualified'):
        if k not in o or (o[k] is not None and type(o[k]) is not bool):raise ValueError('Actual bool or explicit UNKNOWN None required: '+k)
    for k in ('top_support_cue2','crossed2'):
        if k not in o or len(o[k])!=2 or any(type(x) is not bool for x in o[k]):raise ValueError('Actual bool2 required: '+k)
    if o['clean_air_now'] and (min(o['wheel_bottom2'])<=.005 or max(o['wheel_N2'])>1.000001):
        raise ValueError('Incoherent original clean-air/current force/bottom inputs; do not fabricate flight')
    if not 0<=o['global_control']<2000:raise ValueError('Original global2000-control cap')
    if 'actual_joint_q4' in o and (len(o['actual_joint_q4'])!=4 or not all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in o['actual_joint_q4'])):
        raise ValueError('Bad optional actual named leg positions')


class OwnMOD4TeacherReference:
    def __init__(self,parameters):
        self.p=parameters;self.episode=None;self.phase='UNINITIALIZED';self.started=0.
        self.last_leg=parameters.q_stand4;self.start_leg=self.last_leg
        self.had_air=False;self.air_start=None;self.flight_id=0;self.last_air=False
        self.brake_stopped_since=None;self.failure_reason=None;self.last_global_control=None

    def _set(self,phase,t):
        if phase!=self.phase:
            self.phase=phase;self.started=t;self.start_leg=self.last_leg

    def bootstrap(self,q30,joint_names,global_control=0):
        """One first action from actual initialized q; contact is UNKNOWN.

        ROOT must never fabricate zero force before the first physical cache.
        This holds actual leg targets and requests zero wheel velocity only.
        """
        if self.last_global_control is not None or global_control!=0:raise ValueError('Bootstrap is only the first action of a NEW case')
        if len(q30)!=30 or len(joint_names)!=30:raise ValueError('Actual named30 initialization required')
        q=[float(q30[joint_names.index(name)]) for name in ACTION_ORDER[:4]]
        if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in q):raise ValueError('Nonfinite actual initial q')
        for i in (0,2):q[i]=min(q[i+1]+self.p.diff_max,max(q[i+1]+self.p.diff_min,q[i]))
        raw=tuple(max(-6.,min(6.,x/self.p.leg_scale)) for x in q)+(0.,0.)
        self.last_global_control=0;self.last_leg=tuple(q);self.start_leg=self.last_leg
        return dict(raw6=raw,phase='BOOTSTRAP_CONTACT_UNKNOWN',force_and_contact='UNKNOWN_NO_PHYSICAL_CALLBACK_YET',
            original_success='UNKNOWN',physical_teacher_valid=False,no_state_force_reset_or_goal_write=True)

    def step(self,o):
        validate_observation(o)
        p=self.p;t=.01*o['global_control'];air=o['clean_air_now']
        if self.last_global_control is not None and o['global_control']<=self.last_global_control:
            raise ValueError('Replayed/reversed control; new purpose/episode must not reuse consumed controls')
        if self.episode!=o['episode_id']:
            self.episode=o['episode_id'];self.phase='SETTLE';self.started=t
            self.start_leg=tuple(o.get('actual_joint_q4',self.last_leg));self.last_leg=self.start_leg
            self.had_air=False;self.air_start=None;self.last_air=False;self.brake_stopped_since=None;self.failure_reason=None
        self.last_global_control=o['global_control']
        if o['original_done']:
            self._set('TERMINATED',t)
        elif o['original_success']:
            self._set('SUCCESS_HOLD',t)
        elif not o['request_active']:
            self._set('SETTLE',t)
        elif air:
            if not self.last_air:
                self.flight_id+=1;self.had_air=True;self.air_start=t;self._set('FLIGHT_TUCK',t)
            descending=o['world_velocity3'][2]<0
            if self.phase=='FLIGHT_TUCK' and (t-self.started>=p.tuck_s) and descending:
                if all(o['crossed2']) or (min(o['wheel_front2'])>=.37 and min(o['wheel_bottom2'])>=p.minimum_bottom_before_air_extend_m):
                    self._set('AIR_EXTEND',t)
        elif self.had_air and self.last_air:
            if any(o['top_support_cue2']):self._set('LAND_ABSORB',t)
            else:self.failure_reason='real_contact_before_top_landing';self._set('ABORT_BRAKE',t)
        else:
            elapsed=t-self.started
            if self.phase=='SETTLE':self._set('BACKOFF' if max(o['wheel_front2'])>p.runway_start_front_m+.015 else 'BRAKE_BACKOFF',t)
            elif self.phase=='BACKOFF' and max(o['wheel_front2'])<=p.runway_start_front_m+.015:self._set('BRAKE_BACKOFF',t)
            elif self.phase=='BRAKE_BACKOFF':
                if abs(o['world_velocity3'][0])<.1:
                    if self.brake_stopped_since is None:self.brake_stopped_since=t
                    if t-self.brake_stopped_since>=p.brake_hold_s:self._set('ACCELERATE',t)
                else:self.brake_stopped_since=None
            elif self.phase=='ACCELERATE' and elapsed>=p.acceleration_s:self._set('CROUCH',t)
            elif self.phase=='CROUCH' and elapsed>=p.crouch_s:self._set('CROUCH_COAST',t)
            elif self.phase=='CROUCH_COAST' and max(o['wheel_front2'])>=p.launch_front_m-p.teacher_vx*p.push_s:self._set('PUSH',t)
            elif self.phase=='PUSH' and elapsed>=p.push_s:self._set('PUSH_HOLD',t)
            elif self.phase=='PUSH_HOLD' and elapsed>=p.extra_push_hold_s:
                self.failure_reason='no_true_both_wheel_takeoff';self._set('ABORT_BRAKE',t)
            elif self.phase=='LAND_ABSORB' and elapsed>=p.landing_absorb_s:self._set('STABILIZE',t)
        # Late grounded approach is a failed reference; braking never changes
        # original reset/termination/event counters or manufactures clearance.
        if self.phase in {'ACCELERATE','CROUCH','CROUCH_COAST','PUSH','PUSH_HOLD'}:
            if max(o['wheel_front2'])>=.31 and min(o['wheel_bottom2'])<.27 and not air:
                self.failure_reason='late_grounded_approach_before_riser';self._set('ABORT_BRAKE',t)
        elapsed=t-self.started;zero=(0.,)*4;ff=zero;desired_vx=0.
        if self.phase=='SETTLE':leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_stand4,smooth(elapsed/p.settle_pose_s))
        elif self.phase=='BACKOFF':
            distance=max(o['wheel_front2'])-p.runway_start_front_m
            desired_vx=-min(p.backoff_speed_m_s,max(.10,1.5*distance));leg=p.q_stand4
        elif self.phase=='ACCELERATE':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx*smooth(elapsed/p.acceleration_s);leg=p.q_stand4
        elif self.phase=='CROUCH':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_crouch4,smooth(elapsed/p.crouch_s))
        elif self.phase=='CROUCH_COAST':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=p.q_crouch4
        elif self.phase in {'PUSH','PUSH_HOLD'}:
            u=smooth(elapsed/p.push_s) if self.phase=='PUSH' else 1.
            desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=blend(p.q_crouch4,p.q_stand4,u);ff=blend(p.push_tau_crouch4,p.push_tau_extend4,u)
        elif self.phase=='FLIGHT_TUCK':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_air_tuck4,smooth(elapsed/p.tuck_s))
        elif self.phase=='AIR_EXTEND':desired_vx=p.teacher_vx;leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_stand4,smooth(elapsed/p.air_extend_s))
        elif self.phase=='LAND_ABSORB':leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_land4,smooth(elapsed/p.landing_absorb_s))
        elif self.phase=='STABILIZE':leg=blend(self.start_leg,p.q_stand4,smooth(elapsed/p.recovery_rise_s))
        else:leg=p.q_stand4
        self.last_leg=tuple(leg)
        command=[q+tau/p.leg_nominal_kp for q,tau in zip(leg,ff)]
        if self.phase in GROUND_PHASES:
            correction=p.roll_leg_gain*o['root_roll']+p.roll_leg_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][0]
            command=[q+d for q,d in zip(command,(correction,-correction,-correction,correction))]
        for i in (0,2):command[i]=min(command[i+1]+p.diff_max,max(command[i+1]+p.diff_min,command[i]))
        vx=o['world_velocity3'][0]
        # Ground wheel-balance seed: gains are engineering/controller values,
        # not physical forces or a promise of stability. In air this requests
        # wheel reaction/landing speed, never direct COM acceleration.
        omega=vx/p.wheel_radius_m+p.wheel_pitch_gain*o['root_pitch']+p.wheel_pitch_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][1]+p.speed_error_gain*(desired_vx-vx)
        yaw_rate=-p.yaw_gain*o['root_yaw']-p.yaw_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][2]-p.lateral_gain*o['root_y']
        differential=p.track_m/(2*p.wheel_radius_m)*yaw_rate
        unbounded=[q/p.leg_scale for q in command]+[p.wheel_radius_m*(omega-differential)/p.wheel_forward_gain2_m[0]/p.wheel_scale,
            p.wheel_radius_m*(omega+differential)/p.wheel_forward_gain2_m[1]/p.wheel_scale]
        raw=tuple(max(-6.,min(6.,x)) for x in unbounded)
        self.last_air=air
        return dict(raw6=raw,phase=self.phase,planned_leg_target4=tuple(command),nominal_push_feedforward_tau4=ff,
            requested_teacher_vx=desired_vx,actual_original_command_vx=o['actual_command_vx'],
            command_publisher_unchanged=True,runway_start_front_design_m=p.runway_start_front_m,
            runway_must_be_reached_by_actual_wheel_motion=True,flight_id=self.flight_id,
            observed_clean_air=air,observed_qualified=o['qualified'],observed_crossed2=tuple(o['crossed2']),
            observed_original_success=o['original_success'],observed_original_done=o['original_done'],
            original_success_only_source_of_success=True,failure_reason=self.failure_reason,
            top_support_cue_is_control_feedback_not_qualification=True,
            raw_saturation6=tuple(abs(a-b)>1e-12 for a,b in zip(unbounded,raw)),
            process_ready_observed_not_overridden=o['process_ready'],
            feedforward_is_nominal_not_actual_motor_torque=True,
            physical_teacher_valid=False,no_state_force_reset_or_goal_write=True)


def parameters_from_own_seed(import_contract,projected_seed,bounded_lp,own_geometry):
    names=projected_seed['joint_names'];indices=[names.index(n) for n in ACTION_ORDER[:4]]
    q=projected_seed['q30_reference_only'];stand=tuple(float(q[0][j]) for j in indices);tuck=tuple(float(q[4][j]) for j in indices)
    rows={row['pose']:row for row in bounded_lp['rows']}
    ext_tau=tuple(rows['extension']['tau6_Nm'][:4]);tuck_tau=tuple(rows['tuck']['tau6_Nm'][:4])
    mass=sum(b['mass_kg'] for b in import_contract['bodies'].values());radius=import_contract['wheel_motor']['wheel_radius_m']
    h=projected_seed['seed_pose_diagnostics']['extension']['COM_floor_reference_z_m']-radius
    wheel_acceleration_gain=2*.6/(mass*radius);frequency=4.;damping_ratio=.9
    forward_gain,proof=wheel_forward_gains_from_own_fk(import_contract,own_geometry,names,q[0])
    values=dict(q_stand4=stand,q_crouch4=tuck,q_air_tuck4=tuck,q_land4=blend(stand,tuck,.35),
        push_tau_crouch4=tuck_tau,push_tau_extend4=ext_tau,
        teacher_vx=float(projected_seed['variables']['vx_m_s']),acceleration_s=float(projected_seed['variables']['acceleration_s']),
        wheel_radius_m=radius,wheel_forward_gain2_m=forward_gain,wheel_pitch_gain=(9.81+h*frequency**2)/wheel_acceleration_gain,
        wheel_pitch_rate_gain=2*damping_ratio*frequency*h/wheel_acceleration_gain,speed_error_gain=2/wheel_acceleration_gain)
    return TeacherParameters(**values)


def observation_from_existing_callback(cache,meta):
    """ROOT's unbatched N1 original-phase cache -> scalar source inputs.

    cache: kw/result/last_measured from ONE original physical(**kw) call;
    meta: original next-action clock/done, existing root buffer and origin.
    No contact query, state extrapolation, model, RNG or source-env mutation.
    The top cue is explicitly an engineering controller cue, not a claim that
    original top12/stable200 or same-flight qualification has been attained.
    """
    if cache is None:raise ValueError('Initial callback measurements UNKNOWN; use bootstrap(actual q30) once')
    kw=cache['kw'];result=cache['result'];last=cache['last_measured'];origin=meta['env_origin3_world']
    low=last['step_wheel_min'];high=last['step_wheel_max'];forces=tuple(float(x) for x in kw['wheel_N'])
    bottom=tuple(float(x[2]-origin[2]) for x in low);front=tuple(float(x[0]-origin[0]) for x in high)
    top_face=last['step_platform_contact']
    top_cue=tuple(bool(top_face[i]) and forces[i]>1. and bottom[i]>=.269 for i in (0,1))
    root=meta['root_xyz_world'];world_v=meta['root_vxyz_world'];world_w=meta['root_omega_xyz_world']
    o=dict(episode_id=int(meta['episode_id']),global_control=int(meta['global_control']),
        public_age=int(meta['public_age_for_action']),request_active=meta['request_active_for_action'],
        process_ready=meta.get('process_ready',None),qualified=meta.get('reward126_qualified',None),
        root_pitch=float(kw['pitch']),root_roll=float(kw['roll']),root_yaw=float(kw['yaw']),
        root_y=float(root[1]-origin[1]),world_velocity3=tuple(float(x) for x in world_v),
        world_angular_velocity3=tuple(float(x) for x in world_w),wheel_front2=front,wheel_bottom2=bottom,wheel_N2=forces,
        clean_air_now=result['air'],top_support_cue2=top_cue,
        full_footprint=all(last['step_footprint_inside']),crossed2=tuple(bool(x) for x in last['step_first_cross_clear']),
        original_success=last['step_goal_success'],original_done=meta['original_done'],
        actual_command_vx=float(meta['actual_command_vx']),
        original_stable_callbacks=last['step_stable_ticks'],prepared_now=result['prepared'],
        top_cue_source='cached_query_top_ID_and_existing_force_gt1_and_bottom_ge269mm_CONTROL_CUE_ONLY')
    if 'q30' in meta and 'joint_names' in meta:
        o['actual_joint_q4']=tuple(float(meta['q30'][meta['joint_names'].index(n)]) for n in ACTION_ORDER[:4])
    validate_observation(o);return o

"""Pure translation of the existing original callback cache to frozen teacher."""
from own_mod4_teacher_raw6_reference_v1 import TeacherParameters,OwnMOD4TeacherReference,observation_from_existing_callback

class BoundController:
    def __init__(self,parameters):self.controller=OwnMOD4TeacherReference(TeacherParameters(**parameters))
    def step(self,observation):
        if observation['kind']=='initial_contact_unknown':
            return self.controller.bootstrap(observation['q30'],observation['joint_names'],global_control=0)
        return self.controller.step(observation['source_observation'])

def build_controller(parameters):return BoundController(parameters)

def observation_from_cache(state,control):
    if not state['measurements_available']:
        if control!=0:raise ValueError('Missing physical callback after first action')
        return dict(kind='initial_contact_unknown',q30=list(state['q30']),joint_names=list(state['named_joint_order']))
    if state['next_age_control']!=control:raise ValueError('Next-action clock differs from actual public age')
    if 'actual_original_done' not in state:raise ValueError('Prior original termination result is unknown')
    root=state['root13_sdk_xyzw'];goal=state['original_goal']
    cache=dict(kw=state['physical_arguments'],result=state['original_physical_result'],last_measured=dict(
        step_wheel_min=state['wheel_low_world'],step_wheel_max=state['wheel_high_world'],
        step_platform_contact=state['actual_top_face'],step_footprint_inside=state['actual_full_footprint'],
        step_first_cross_clear=state['original_crossed2'],step_stable_ticks=goal['stable_ticks'],step_goal_success=goal['success']))
    meta=dict(episode_id=int(state['episode_id']),global_control=control,public_age_for_action=state['next_age_control'],
        request_active_for_action=state['next_request_active'],original_done=state['actual_original_done'],
        actual_command_vx=state['actual_command_vx_for_action'],env_origin3_world=state['env_origin3_world'],
        root_xyz_world=root[:3],root_vxyz_world=root[7:10],root_omega_xyz_world=root[10:13],
        process_ready=None,reward126_qualified=None,q30=state['q30'],joint_names=state['named_joint_order'])
    observation=observation_from_existing_callback(cache,meta)
    return dict(kind='original_cached_physical',source_observation=observation,
        physical_measurement_public_age=state['age_control'],next_action_public_age=control)

import hashlib,json,math,types
from teacher140_task_guard_v1 import require

def plain(value):
    if hasattr(value,'torch'):value=value.torch
    if hasattr(value,'detach'):return value.detach().cpu().tolist()
    if isinstance(value,dict):return {k:plain(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,(tuple,list)):return [plain(x) for x in value]
    if isinstance(value,float):require(math.isfinite(value),'nonfinite diagnostic value')
    return value

class ProducerStream:
    def __init__(self,path,kind,domain):
        self.path=Path(path);self.kind=kind;self.domain=domain;self.file=self.path.open('xb');self.rows=0;self.bytes=0;self.sha=hashlib.sha256()
    def write(self,value):
        b=(json.dumps(plain(value),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode('utf8')
        self.file.write(b);self.sha.update(b);self.bytes+=len(b);self.rows+=1
    def close(self):
        self.file.flush();self.file.close()
        require(self.path.stat().st_size==self.bytes,'producer byte count')
        return dict(path=str(self.path),bytes=self.bytes,SHA=self.sha.hexdigest(),rows=self.rows,kind=self.kind,domain=self.domain,producer_counted_in_single_write_pass=True,no_content_reread=True)

class OriginalCachedPhaseObserver:
    def __init__(self,env,stream):

        self.last=None;self.terminal=None;self.terms_calls=0;self.installed=False
    def tensor(self,x):
        if hasattr(x,'torch'):return x.torch
        return x

        row=dict(physics_callback=self.callbacks,control_for_action=self.control_for_action,physical_time_s=self.callbacks*.0025,
            age_control=int(p.age_control[0]),request_for_action=bool(p.request_for_action[0]),measurements_available=measured,
            root13_sdk_xyzw=root,q30=q,dq30=dq,env_origin3_world=origin,
            named_joint_order=list(r.joint_names),body_order=list(r.body_names),
            original_goal={k:tensor(getattr(p.goal,k))[0].clone() for k in ('success','stable_ticks','launched','landed','edge','attempt')},
            original_counts={k:int(getattr(p,k)[0]) for k in ('takeoff_count','landing_count','recovery_count')})
        if measured:
            row.update(physical_arguments={k:tensor(v)[0].clone() for k,v in kw.items()},
                original_physical_result={k:tensor(v)[0].clone() for k,v in result.items()},
                wheel_low_world=cache['step_wheel_min'][0].clone(),wheel_high_world=cache['step_wheel_max'][0].clone(),
                actual_top_face=cache['step_platform_contact'][0].clone(),actual_full_footprint=cache['step_footprint_inside'][0].clone(),
                original_crossed2=p.crossed[0].clone(),
                physical_applied_processed6=__import__('torch').cat([tensor(e._physics_action_delay.queue.groups[k]['applied']) for k in ('legs','wheels')],-1)[0].clone(),
                original_raw_action6=e.action_manager.action[0].clone(),
                body_position31=tensor(r.data.body_pos_w)[0].clone(),body_quaternion31_sdk_xyzw=tensor(r.data.body_quat_w)[0].clone())
        return row
    def install(self):
        require(not self.installed,'install once');self.old_physical=self.phase.physical;self.old_term=self.env.termination_manager.compute
        observer=self
        def physical(this,**kw):
            result=observer.old_physical(**kw)
            observer.callbacks+=1;require(observer.callbacks<=8000,'original callback maximum')
            observer.last=observer.state(kw,result)
            observer.stream.write(dict(schema='mod4.teacher140.cached_original_callback.v1',state=observer.last))
            return result
        def term(*args,**kwargs):
            value=observer.old_term(*args,**kwargs)
            if observer.env.h1_stepping:
                observer.terms_calls+=1;manager=observer.env.termination_manager
                names=manager._term_names;dones=observer.tensor(manager._term_dones)
                require(dones.shape==(1,len(names)),'cached termination matrix')
                observer.terminal=dict(state=observer.last,aggregate_done=observer.tensor(value).clone(),
                    original_terms={name:bool(dones[0,i]) for i,name in enumerate(names)},
                    original_compute_called_once=True,cached_terms_no_recompute=True)
            return value
        self.phase.physical=types.MethodType(physical,self.phase);self.env.termination_manager.compute=term;self.installed=True
        return dict(original_physical_single_call=True,original_result_returned_unchanged=True,no_extra_contact_getter=True,no_reset_RNG_or_guard_change=True)
    def restore(self):
        if self.installed:
            self.phase.physical=self.old_physical;self.env.termination_manager.compute=self.old_term;self.installed=False

def plain(value):
    if hasattr(value,'torch'):value=value.torch
    if hasattr(value,'detach'):return value.detach().cpu().tolist()
    if isinstance(value,dict):return {k:plain(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,(tuple,list)):return [plain(x) for x in value]
    if isinstance(value,float):require(math.isfinite(value),'nonfinite diagnostic value')
    return value

class ProducerStream:
    def __init__(self,path,kind,domain):
        self.path=Path(path);self.kind=kind;self.domain=domain;self.file=self.path.open('xb');self.rows=0;self.bytes=0;self.sha=hashlib.sha256()
    def write(self,value):
        b=(json.dumps(plain(value),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode('utf8')
        self.file.write(b);self.sha.update(b);self.bytes+=len(b);self.rows+=1
    def close(self):
        self.file.flush();self.file.close()
        require(self.path.stat().st_size==self.bytes,'producer byte count')
        return dict(path=str(self.path),bytes=self.bytes,SHA=self.sha.hexdigest(),rows=self.rows,kind=self.kind,domain=self.domain,producer_counted_in_single_write_pass=True,no_content_reread=True)

    q=subprocess.run(['pwsh.exe','-NoProfile','-Command',command],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf8',check=True)

from pathlib import Path
import collections, datetime, hashlib, json, math, traceback

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def dump(path, value):
    with path.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(value,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)

def main():
    protocol=json.loads((HERE/'PURPOSE_AND_SINGLE_READ_ADMISSION.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==protocol['source_SHA']
    dump(HERE/'CONSUMED_BEFORE_NEW_NUMERICAL_INPUT_READ.json',dict(
        purpose=protocol['purpose'],utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        new_analysis_reads_per_input=1,no_raw_JSONL_PT_NPZ_SDK_model_GPU_or_network=True))
    reads=[]
    try:
        data={}
        for row in protocol['inputs']:
            b=Path(row['path']).read_bytes()
            reads.append(dict(**row,actual_bytes=len(b),actual_SHA=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
                              new_numerical_content_reads=1))
            assert len(b)==row['bytes'] and reads[-1]['actual_SHA']==row['SHA']
            data[row['key']]=json.loads(b)
        trace=data['trajectory']; initial=data['initial']; p=data['parameters']
        assert trace['schema']=='mod4.teacher140.small_actual_trajectory_fit.v1'
        rows=trace['rows'];assert len(rows)==trace['controls']==127
        assert [r['control'] for r in rows]==list(range(127))
        assert trace['control_dt_s']==.01 and trace['physics_dt_s']==.0025
        phases=collections.Counter(r['phase'] for r in rows)
        compact=[]; errors=[]
        for i,r in enumerate(rows):
            root=r['root13_sdk_xyzw'];kw=r['physical_arguments']
            assert len(root)==13 and len(r['raw6'])==6
            rec=dict(control=r['control'],control_end_time_s=(i+1)*.01,
                phase=r['phase'],root_xyz=root[:3],root_quat_sdk_xyzw=root[3:7],
                world_vxyz=root[7:10],world_omega_xyz=root[10:13],
                pitch=float(kw['pitch']),roll=float(kw['roll']),yaw=float(kw['yaw']),
                wheel_forces_N=kw['wheel_N'],wheel_low_world=r['wheel_low_world'],
                wheel_high_world=r['wheel_high_world'],raw6=r['raw6'],
                commanded_leg_target4=[.5*x for x in r['raw6'][:4]],
                commanded_wheel_speed2=[10*x for x in r['raw6'][4:]],
                original_goal=r['original_goal'])
            if i:
                prev=rows[i-1];s=prev['root13_sdk_xyzw'];w=prev['physical_arguments']
                vx=s[7];pitch=float(w['pitch']);wy=s[11]
                terms=dict(no_slip_feedforward=vx/p['wheel_radius_m'],
                    pitch_feedback=p['wheel_pitch_gain']*pitch,
                    angular_rate_feedback=p['wheel_pitch_rate_gain']*wy,
                    speed_feedback=-p['speed_error_gain']*vx)
                omega=sum(terms.values())
                origin=initial['env_origin3_world']
                yr=-p['yaw_gain']*float(w['yaw'])-p['yaw_rate_gain']*s[12]-p['lateral_gain']*(s[1]-origin[1])
                differential=p['track_m']/(2*p['wheel_radius_m'])*yr
                predicted=[max(-6.,min(6.,p['wheel_radius_m']*(omega+sign*differential)/g/p['wheel_scale']))
                    for sign,g in zip((-1,1),p['wheel_forward_gain2_m'])]
                residual=max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(predicted,r['raw6'][4:]))
                errors.append(residual)

            compact.append(rec)
        # This diagnostic checks the consumed source formula, not a new control law.
        formula_matches=max(errors)<2e-5
        picks=sorted(set([0,9,24,49,74,99,124,126]))
        result=dict(schema='mod4.teacher140.preparation_numerical_review142.v1',

    exactFK = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, qExact, root(1:3), initialR);
    % Existing own passive-IK helper, fixed actual motor4. This is numeric
    % preparation of an OFFLINE model, never a new reset/precision gate.
    [q, projection] = closeLanding(C, G, names, qExact, act, q4Hold);
    assert(max(abs(q(act(1:4))-q4Hold)) == 0, 'Never replace actual motor hold pose.');

    state = struct('p', position, 'R', R, 'v', zeros(3, 1), 'w', zeros(3, 1), 'q', q, 'dq', zeros(30, 1));
    d = own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C, G, names, state);
    g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, position, R);
    [points, JC] = contactsAndJ(G, d);
    [~, rr, pivot] = qr(d.loop_J(:, 7:36).', 'vector'); dd = abs(diag(rr));
    rankTolerance = 1e-9*max([dd; 1]); rankJ = sum(dd > rankTolerance); selected = pivot(1:rankJ);
    solution = staticEffort(C, p, names, q, act, d, d.loop_J(selected, :), JC, []);
    [lineDistance, fraction] = supportLine(d.COM, points);
    status = 'ACTUAL_INITIAL_SOURCE_STATIC_NOT_EQUILIBRIUM_NOT_TEACHER';
    if strcmp(solution.status, 'ALTERNATE_POINT_CONTACT_STATIC_EQUATIONS_SATISFIED_NOT_PHYSX_OR_STABILITY')
        status = 'ACTUAL_INITIAL_SOURCE_STATIC_HARD_EQUATIONS_SATISFIED_NOT_PHYSX_STABILITY';
    end
    report = struct('schema', 'OWN_MOD4_ACTUAL_INITIAL_STATIC_SOURCE_V4A', 'status', status, ...
        'producer_pid', feature('getpid'), 'inputs', inputs, 'named_joint_order', {names}, ...
        'actuation_order6', {order}, 'actual_initial_state_from_ROOT142', actual, ...
        'actual_q30', qExact, 'q4_hold_target_actual', q4Hold, ...
        'old_high_stand_target4_not_used', p.q_stand4, ...
        'offline_projected_passive_q30', q, 'offline_passive_projection_delta30', q-qExact, ...
        'offline_projection_max_coordinate_change', max(abs(q-qExact)), 'passive_projection', projection, ...
        'actual_initial_exact_FK_anchor_max_m', exactFK.closure_max_m, ...
        'actual_initial_authored_wheel_bottom_m', exactFK.wheel_low(3, :)-origin(3), ...
        'actual_initial_contact_measurements', 'UNKNOWN_NO_CALLBACK_AT_INITIAL_HEADER', ...
        'reference_yaw_actual_initial_rad', yaw, 'reference_pitch_rad', angles(1), 'reference_roll_rad', angles(2), ...
        'reference_R_world_from_chassis', R, 'reference_root_position_OFFLINE_ONLY', position, ...
        'reference_COM_world_m', d.COM, 'reference_wheel_support_world_m', points, ...
        'reference_COM_line_distance_m', lineDistance, 'reference_COM_support_fraction', fraction, ...
        'reference_all6_anchor_m', vecnorm(g.closure_residual), 'reference_mimic_residual', g.mimic_residual, ...
        'angle_solver', angleSolver, 'joint_only_loop_rank', rankJ, ...
        'joint_only_loop_rank_tolerance', rankTolerance, 'selected_loop_rows', selected, ...
        'nominal_gas', {d.gas}, 'static_solution', solution, ...
        'model_scope', 'Own31body nominal M/h/J and two authored pointcontacts with assumedmu.7; not original cooked PhysX', ...
        'original_command_publisher_unchanged', .5, 'no_high_stand_initial_interpolation', true, ...
        'no_q_root_velocity_force_or_reset_write', true, 'source_model_numeric_projection_not_runtime_guard', true, ...
        'dynamic_stability_or_teacher_proven', false, 'physical_teacher_valid', false, 'runtime_admission', false);

    report = struct('schema', 'OWN_MOD4_ACTUAL_INITIAL_STATIC_SOURCE_V4A', ...
        'status', 'ORIGINAL_ACTUAL_INITIAL_STATIC_SOURCE_ERROR_RETAINED', ...
        'producer_pid', feature('getpid'), 'inputs', inputs, 'message', error.message, ...
        'identifier', error.identifier, 'stack', error.stack, ...
        'full_report', getReport(error, 'extended', 'hyperlinks', 'off'), 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
end

end
