function [q, receipt] = closeLanding(C, G, names, initial, act, target)
fixed = act(1:4);
dependent = [];
for j = 1:30
    child = C.joints.(names{j}).child;
    if ~ismember(j, fixed) && ~startsWith(names{j}, 'guide_roller_') && ~ismember(child, {'left_wheel', 'right_wheel'})
        dependent(end+1) = j; %#ok<AGROW>
    end
end
assert(numel(dependent) == 16, 'Own16 dependent passive/mimic coordinates expected.');
q = initial; q(fixed) = target;
lb = -inf(16, 1); ub = inf(16, 1);
for j = 1:16
    lim = C.joints.(names{dependent(j)}).limits_si;
    if ~isempty(lim), lb(j) = lim(1); ub(j) = lim(2); end
end
x0 = q(dependent);
assert(all(x0 >= lb & x0 <= ub), 'Initial guess is outside real authored bounds; do not silently clamp.');
before = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
options = optimoptions('fmincon', 'Display', 'off', 'Algorithm', 'sqp', ...
    'MaxIterations', 200, 'MaxFunctionEvaluations', 6000, 'FunctionTolerance', 1e-14, ...
    'OptimalityTolerance', 1e-10, 'StepTolerance', 1e-12);
objective = @(x) landingObjective(C, G, names, q, dependent, x);
[x, value, flag, solver] = fmincon(objective, x0, [], [], [], [], lb, ub, [], options);
q(dependent) = x;
after = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
receipt = struct('dependent_names', {names(dependent)}, 'fixed_motor_names', {names(fixed)}, ...
    'fixed_motor_target4', target, 'initial_anchor_max_m', before.closure_max_m, ...
    'solved_anchor_max_m', after.closure_max_m, 'mimic_residual', after.mimic_residual, ...
    'exitflag', flag, 'objective', value, 'solver', solver, ...
    'is_passive_interpolation_claimed_closed', false, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
assert(after.closure_max_m <= .002 && max(abs(after.mimic_residual)) < 1e-6, 'Landing IK did not produce a closed offline pose.');
end

function value = landingObjective(C, G, names, q, dependent, x)
q(dependent) = x;
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
value = sum((1000*g.constraint_vector).^2);
end

function [angles, receipt] = alignCOM(C, G, names, q)
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
points = wheelSupportPoints(G, g.body_names, g.body_position, g.body_rotation);
delta = g.COM-mean(points, 2);
initial = [atan2(-delta(1), delta(3)); 0];
assert(abs(initial(1)) <= .6, 'COM balance initial pitch outside declared offline search range.');
options = optimoptions('fmincon', 'Display', 'off', 'Algorithm', 'sqp', ...
    'MaxIterations', 120, 'MaxFunctionEvaluations', 1200, 'FunctionTolerance', 1e-16, ...
    'OptimalityTolerance', 1e-10, 'StepTolerance', 1e-12);
objective = @(a) alignmentObjective(C, G, names, q, a);
[angles, value, flag, solver] = fmincon(objective, initial, [], [], [], [], [-.6; -.3], [.6; .3], [], options);
[~, errors] = alignmentObjective(C, G, names, q, angles);
receipt = struct('base_pitch_roll_rad', angles, 'initial_pitch_roll_rad', initial, ...
    'offline_search_bounds_pitch_roll_rad', [-.6, .6; -.3, .3], ...
    'search_bounds_are_not_actual_robot_limits', true, 'residual_COM_line_and_wheel_height_m', errors, ...
    'exitflag', flag, 'objective', value, 'solver', solver, ...
    'geometry_only_not_angular_momentum_or_dynamic_stability', true);
end

function [value, error] = alignmentObjective(C, G, names, q, angles)
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, zeros(3, 1), ry(angles(1))*rx(angles(2)));
points = wheelSupportPoints(G, g.body_names, g.body_position, g.body_rotation);
distance = supportLine(g.COM, points);
error = [distance; points(3, 1)-points(3, 2)];
value = sum((1000*error).^2);
end

function roll = levelRoll(C, G, names, q, pitch)
fun = @(a) wheelHeightDifference(C, G, names, q, pitch, a);
assert(fun(-.3)*fun(.3) <= 0, 'Wheel-level roll is not bracketed in the offline comparison box.');
roll = fzero(fun, [-.3, .3]);
end

function difference = wheelHeightDifference(C, G, names, q, pitch, roll)
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, zeros(3, 1), ry(pitch)*rx(roll));
difference = g.wheel_low(3, 1)-g.wheel_low(3, 2);
end

function [distance, fraction] = supportLine(COM, points)
line = points(1:2, 2)-points(1:2, 1);
offset = COM(1:2)-points(1:2, 1);
assert(norm(line) > .1, 'Own two wheel transverse support line required.');
distance = (line(2)*offset(1)-line(1)*offset(2))/norm(line);
fraction = (offset.'*line)/(line.'*line);
end

function solution = staticEffort(C, p, names, q, act, d, J, JC, fixedTorque)
r = size(J, 1); n = 6+r+6;
E = [d.B_action_torque_order6, J.', JC.'];
b = d.h-d.gas_generalized_force;
peak = [C.leg_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(2, 1)];
continuous = [C.leg_motor.continuous_torque_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.continuous_torque_nm*ones(2, 1)];
lb = [-peak; -inf(r+6, 1)]; ub = [peak; inf(r+6, 1)];
if ~isempty(fixedTorque)
    lb(1:6) = fixedTorque; ub(1:6) = fixedTorque;
end
for wheel = 1:2, lb(6+r+(wheel-1)*3+3) = 0; end
A = []; rhs = []; mu = .7;
for wheel = 1:2
    idx = 6+r+(wheel-1)*3+(1:3);
    for sx = [-1, 1]
        for sy = [-1, 1]
            row = zeros(1, n); row(idx) = [sx, sy, -mu];
            A = [A; row]; rhs = [rhs; 0]; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
    end
end
for j = 1:4
    % Position targets may exceed a named JOINT STATE limit intentionally.
    % Only original raw +/-6 and CAD target projection constrain this solve.
    row = zeros(1, n); row(j) = 1/60;
    A = [A; row; -row]; rhs = [rhs; 3-q(act(j)); 3+q(act(j))]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
for j = [1, 3]
    row = zeros(1, n); row(j) = 1/60; row(j+1) = -1/60;
    delta = q(act(j))-q(act(j+1));
    A = [A; row; -row]; rhs = [rhs; p.diff_max-delta; delta-p.diff_min]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
for j = 5:6
    row = zeros(1, n); row(j) = 1/.6;
    A = [A; row; -row]; rhs = [rhs; 60; 60]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
[~, RR, pivot] = qr(E.', 'vector'); diagonal = abs(diag(RR));
eqTolerance = 1e-10*max([diagonal; 1]); eqRank = sum(diagonal > eqTolerance);
selectedEq = pivot(1:eqRank);
H = diag([1./peak.^2; 1e-12*ones(r, 1); 1e-8/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81)^2*ones(6, 1)]);
options = optimoptions('quadprog', 'Display', 'off', 'Algorithm', 'interior-point-convex', ...
    'MaxIterations', 400, 'ConstraintTolerance', 1e-9, 'OptimalityTolerance', 1e-9);
[z, value, flag, solver] = quadprog(H, zeros(n, 1), A, rhs, E(selectedEq, :), b(selectedEq), lb, ub, [], options);
hardFlag = flag; hardSolver = solver; usedSoft = false;
if isempty(z) || flag <= 0 || max(abs(E*z-b)) > 1e-6
    % A bounded least-residual diagnostic is preserved as a failure to prove
    % static equilibrium. It is never relabelled as an equality solution.
    scale = ones(36, 1)/40;
    scale(1:3) = 1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81);
    scale(4:6) = 1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81*.3);
    for j = 1:30
        if strcmp(C.joints.(names{j}).type, 'slide'), scale(6+j) = 1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81); end
    end
    W2 = diag(scale.^2);
    softH = E.'*W2*E+1e-8*H;
    softH = (softH+softH.')/2;
    [z, value, flag, solver] = quadprog(softH, -E.'*W2*b, A, rhs, [], [], lb, ub, [], options);
    usedSoft = true;
end
if isempty(z) || any(~isfinite(z))
    solution = struct('status', 'NO_STATIC_OR_BOUNDED_RESIDUAL_SOLUTION', ...
        'hard_exitflag', hardFlag, 'hard_solver', hardSolver, ...
        'last_exitflag', flag, 'last_solver', solver, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
    return;
end
tau = z(1:6); lambda = z(7:6+r); forces = reshape(z(7+r:end), 3, 2);
residual = E*z-b;
pd = mapTorqueThroughOriginalPD(C, p, q, act, tau);
mappedResidual = d.B_action_torque_order6*pd.actual_torque6_after_nominal_two_signed_clips+J.'*lambda+JC.'*forces(:)-b;
maxConstraintViolation = max([0; A*z-rhs; lb-z; z-ub]);
isEquality = ~usedSoft && flag > 0 && max(abs(residual)) <= 1e-6 ...
    && max(abs(mappedResidual)) <= 1e-6 && maxConstraintViolation <= 1e-6;
status = 'BOUNDED_LEAST_RESIDUAL_NOT_A_STATIC_EQUILIBRIUM_PROOF';
if isEquality, status = 'ALTERNATE_POINT_CONTACT_STATIC_EQUATIONS_SATISFIED_NOT_PHYSX_OR_STABILITY'; end
solution = struct('status', status, 'hard_exitflag', hardFlag, 'hard_solver', hardSolver, ...
    'used_soft_residual_fallback', usedSoft, 'last_exitflag', flag, 'last_solver', solver, ...
    'objective', value, 'tau6_Nm', tau, 'loop_lambda_selected', lambda, ...
    'ground_reaction_world_N', forces, 'mu_assumed_not_measured', mu, ...
    'static_generalized_residual36', residual, 'root_force_residual_N', residual(1:3), ...
    'root_moment_residual_Nm', residual(4:6), 'joint_generalized_residual30', residual(7:36), ...
    'max_mixed_unit_residual', max(abs(residual)), ...
    'all36_residual_after_original_PD_and_clips', mappedResidual, ...
    'static_linear_system_rank', eqRank, 'selected_equality_rows', selectedEq, ...
    'equality_rank_numerical_tolerance', eqTolerance, 'static_matrix_singular_values', svd(E), ...
    'unbounded_nullspace_consistency_residual', b-E*(pinv(E)*b), ...
    'max_inequality_or_bound_violation', maxConstraintViolation, 'peak_effort_limit6_Nm', peak, ...
    'remaining_peak_effort6_Nm', peak-abs(tau), 'continuous_rating6_Nm', continuous, ...
    'within_continuous_rating6', abs(tau) <= continuous, ...
    'continuous_rating_is_not_the_original_runtime_clip', true, ...
    'nominal_PD_target', pd, 'all_velocities_zero', true, ...
    'steady_queue_required_before_claiming_PD_torque', true, ...
    'no_duration_thermal_or_dynamic_stability_proof', true, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
end

function result = mapTorqueThroughOriginalPD(C, p, q, act, torque)
leg = q(act(1:4))+torque(1:4)/60;
wheel = torque(5:6)/.6;
requestedTarget = [leg; wheel];
rawBefore = [leg/.5; wheel/10];
raw = max(-6, min(6, rawBefore));
processed = [.5*raw(1:4); 10*raw(5:6)];
for j = [1, 3]
    processed(j) = min(processed(j+1)+p.diff_max, max(processed(j+1)+p.diff_min, processed(j)));
end
requested = [60*(processed(1:4)-q(act(1:4))); .6*processed(5:6)];
limit = [C.leg_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(2, 1)];
stall = [C.leg_motor.envelope_intercept_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.envelope_intercept_nm*ones(2, 1)];
speed = [C.leg_motor.no_load_speed_rpm*2*pi/60*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.no_load_speed_rpm*2*pi/60*ones(2, 1)];
[first, clip1] = dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1(requested, zeros(6, 1), limit, stall, speed);
[actual, clip2] = dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1(first, zeros(6, 1), limit, stall, speed);
outside = [];
for j = 1:4
    limits = C.joints.(pActionName(j)).limits_si;
    if processed(j) < limits(1) || processed(j) > limits(2), outside(end+1) = j; end %#ok<AGROW>
end
result = struct('requested_equivalent_torque6_Nm', torque, 'qtarget_equals_q_plus_tau_over_kp4', requestedTarget(1:4), ...
    'wheel_velocity_target2_rad_s', wheel, 'raw6_before_original_clip', rawBefore, ...
    'raw6_after_original_clip', raw, 'processed_target6_after_CAD', processed, ...
    'actual_torque6_after_nominal_two_signed_clips', actual, 'actual_minus_equivalent_torque6', actual-torque, ...
    'nominal_episode_step_scales6', ones(6, 1), 'two_clip_origin_captured210_not72_runtime_equivalence', true, ...
    'first_clip', clip1, 'second_clip', clip2, 'target_outside_named_q_domain_indices', outside, ...
    'target_outside_named_q_domain_is_not_actual_q_limit_violation', true, ...
    'deliberate_PD_saturation_is_possible_and_must_be_reported', true, ...
    'state_not_clamped_or_modified', true, 'no_external_force', true);
end

function name = pActionName(j)
names = {'left_crank', 'left_hip', 'right_crank', 'right_hip'};
name = names{j};
end

function domain = actualQDomain(C, names, q, act)
violations = struct('joint', {}, 'q', {}, 'limits', {});
for j = 1:30
    lim = C.joints.(names{j}).limits_si;
    if ~isfinite(q(j)) || (~isempty(lim) && (q(j) < lim(1) || q(j) > lim(2)))
        violations(end+1) = struct('joint', names{j}, 'q', q(j), 'limits', lim); %#ok<AGROW>
    end
end
cad = [];
for j = [1, 3]
    delta = q(act(j))-q(act(j+1));
    if delta < -1.0843 || delta > .85, cad(end+1) = j; end %#ok<AGROW>
end
domain = struct('actual_q30_violations', violations, 'actual_CAD_violations', cad, ...
    'no_actual_state_clamp', true, 'actual_q_and_PD_target_domains_are_distinct', true);
end

function [points, JC] = contactsAndJ(G, d)
names = cellstr(string(G.body_names));
points = wheelSupportPoints(G, names, d.body_position, d.body_rotation);
JC = zeros(6, 36);
for j = 1:2
    wheels = {'left_wheel', 'right_wheel'};
    b = find(strcmp(names, wheels{j}), 1);
    offset = points(:, j)-d.body_position(:, b);
    JC((j-1)*3+(1:3), :) = d.body_origin_Jv(:, :, b)-skew(offset)*d.body_Jw(:, :, b);
end
end

function points = wheelSupportPoints(G, bodyNames, P, R)
shapes = G.shapes; if isstruct(shapes), shapes = num2cell(shapes); end
wheelNames = {'left_wheel', 'right_wheel'};
points = zeros(3, 2);
for j = 1:2
    b = find(strcmp(bodyNames, wheelNames{j}), 1);
    ix = find(cellfun(@(s) strcmp(s.body, wheelNames{j}), shapes));
    assert(numel(ix) == 1 && strcmp(shapes{ix}.type, 'Mesh'), 'Own exact single wheel mesh required.');
    shape = shapes{ix};
    vertices = R(:, :, b)*shape.linear_body_from_shape*shape.points.'+P(:, b)+R(:, :, b)*shape.origin_body_m(:);
    z = min(vertices(3, :));
    points(:, j) = mean(vertices(:, abs(vertices(3, :)-z) < 1e-12), 2);
end
end

    [D, meta] = readJSON4A(derived, 'db4b269a5ce700f71cc4f974bb783409e8e93d208ff9fe784b890cb78cd1d973', 'ROOT142_derived_initial_only_not_original140_inputs'); inputs(end+1) = meta;
    [p, meta] = readJSON4A(parameterPath, 'f1fb410d7e5fc0defcb5beaa0aa4c4404f637588a0f80bd3df366030f508b7d7', 'original140V2_parameter_source'); inputs(end+1) = meta;
    [~, meta] = readPinned4A(fkFile, '94c67925ce701a46a322afff910c916dd0de2c41968d06bc294b92b1d2b99893', 'own_FK'); inputs(end+1) = meta;
    [~, meta] = readPinned4A(matrixFile, '0cd6eb40378130064a5e327c04508bf0682901ad5b51c8d298e72d7d0a238ef4', 'correct_gas2000_M_h_J'); inputs(end+1) = meta;
    [~, meta] = readPinned4A(clipFile, '257a9753b8264d65634f01edf8ce47e4a27e3ee3a1f81bfcace42a090770015f', 'captured210_signed_clip_not72_equivalence'); inputs(end+1) = meta;
    assert(strcmp(D.schema, 'mod4.teacher140.preparation_numerical_review142.v1') && D.passed);
    actual = D.initial_state_exact_from_new140_report;
    names = cellstr(string(actual.named_joint_order)); qExact = actual.q30(:);
    root = actual.root13_sdk_xyzw(:); origin = actual.env_origin3_world(:);
    assert(numel(names) == 30 && numel(qExact) == 30 && numel(root) == 13);
    assert(all(isfinite(qExact)) && all(isfinite(root)) && norm(actual.dq30) == 0 && norm(root(8:13)) == 0);
    assert(~actual.measurements_available, 'The source initial contact measurement remains UNKNOWN.');
    assert(~actual.request_for_action && p.original_command_vx == .5 && p.launch_front_m == .14);
    addpath(fileparts(fkFile), '-begin'); addpath(fileparts(matrixFile), '-begin'); addpath(fileparts(clipFile), '-begin');
    clear own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1 own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1 dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1;
    assert(samePath4A(which('own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1'), fkFile));
    assert(samePath4A(which('own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1'), matrixFile));
    assert(samePath4A(which('dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1'), clipFile));
    order = {'left_crank', 'left_hip', 'right_crank', 'right_hip', 'left_wheel_spin', 'right_wheel_spin'};
    [found, act] = ismember(order, names); assert(all(found));
    q4Hold = qExact(act(1:4));
    rawDomain = actualQDomain(C, names, qExact, act);
    assert(isempty(rawDomain.actual_q30_violations) && isempty(rawDomain.actual_CAD_violations));
    initialR = qmat4A([root(7); root(4:6)]);
    yaw = atan2(initialR(2, 1), initialR(1, 1));
    exactFK = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, qExact, root(1:3), initialR);
    % Existing own passive-IK helper, fixed actual motor4. This is numeric
    % preparation of an OFFLINE model, never a new reset/precision gate.
    [q, projection] = closeLanding(C, G, names, qExact, act, q4Hold);
    assert(max(abs(q(act(1:4))-q4Hold)) == 0, 'Never replace actual motor hold pose.');
    [angles, angleSolver] = alignCOM(C, G, names, q);
    R = rz4A(yaw)*ry(angles(1))*rx(angles(2));
    g0 = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, zeros(3, 1), R);
    position = [root(1); root(2); origin(3)-mean(g0.wheel_low(3, :))];
    state = struct('p', position, 'R', R, 'v', zeros(3, 1), 'w', zeros(3, 1), 'q', q, 'dq', zeros(30, 1));
    d = own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C, G, names, state);
    g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, position, R);
    [points, JC] = contactsAndJ(G, d);
    [~, rr, pivot] = qr(d.loop_J(:, 7:36).', 'vector'); dd = abs(diag(rr));
    rankTolerance = 1e-9*max([dd; 1]); rankJ = sum(dd > rankTolerance); selected = pivot(1:rankJ);
    solution = staticEffort(C, p, names, q, act, d, d.loop_J(selected, :), JC, []);
    [lineDistance, fraction] = supportLine(d.COM, points);
    status = 'ACTUAL_INITIAL_SOURCE_STATIC_NOT_EQUILIBRIUM_NOT_TEACHER';
    if strcmp(solution.status, 'ALTERNATE_POINT_CONTACT_STATIC_EQUATIONS_SATISFIED_NOT_PHYSX_OR_STABILITY')
        status = 'ACTUAL_INITIAL_SOURCE_STATIC_HARD_EQUATIONS_SATISFIED_NOT_PHYSX_STABILITY';
    end
    report = struct('schema', 'OWN_MOD4_ACTUAL_INITIAL_STATIC_SOURCE_V4A', 'status', status, ...
        'producer_pid', feature('getpid'), 'inputs', inputs, 'named_joint_order', {names}, ...
        'actuation_order6', {order}, 'actual_initial_state_from_ROOT142', actual, ...
        'actual_q30', qExact, 'q4_hold_target_actual', q4Hold, ...
        'old_high_stand_target4_not_used', p.q_stand4, ...
        'offline_projected_passive_q30', q, 'offline_passive_projection_delta30', q-qExact, ...
        'offline_projection_max_coordinate_change', max(abs(q-qExact)), 'passive_projection', projection, ...
        'actual_initial_exact_FK_anchor_max_m', exactFK.closure_max_m, ...
        'actual_initial_authored_wheel_bottom_m', exactFK.wheel_low(3, :)-origin(3), ...
        'actual_initial_contact_measurements', 'UNKNOWN_NO_CALLBACK_AT_INITIAL_HEADER', ...
        'reference_yaw_actual_initial_rad', yaw, 'reference_pitch_rad', angles(1), 'reference_roll_rad', angles(2), ...
        'reference_R_world_from_chassis', R, 'reference_root_position_OFFLINE_ONLY', position, ...
        'reference_COM_world_m', d.COM, 'reference_wheel_support_world_m', points, ...
        'reference_COM_line_distance_m', lineDistance, 'reference_COM_support_fraction', fraction, ...
        'reference_all6_anchor_m', vecnorm(g.closure_residual), 'reference_mimic_residual', g.mimic_residual, ...
        'angle_solver', angleSolver, 'joint_only_loop_rank', rankJ, ...
        'joint_only_loop_rank_tolerance', rankTolerance, 'selected_loop_rows', selected, ...
        'nominal_gas', {d.gas}, 'static_solution', solution, ...
        'model_scope', 'Own31body nominal M/h/J and two authored pointcontacts with assumedmu.7; not original cooked PhysX', ...
        'original_command_publisher_unchanged', .5, 'no_high_stand_initial_interpolation', true, ...
        'no_q_root_velocity_force_or_reset_write', true, 'source_model_numeric_projection_not_runtime_guard', true, ...
        'dynamic_stability_or_teacher_proven', false, 'physical_teacher_valid', false, 'runtime_admission', false);
catch error
    report = struct('schema', 'OWN_MOD4_ACTUAL_INITIAL_STATIC_SOURCE_V4A', ...
        'status', 'ORIGINAL_ACTUAL_INITIAL_STATIC_SOURCE_ERROR_RETAINED', ...
        'producer_pid', feature('getpid'), 'inputs', inputs, 'message', error.message, ...
        'identifier', error.identifier, 'stack', error.stack, ...
        'full_report', getReport(error, 'extended', 'hyperlinks', 'off'), 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
end
writeNewJSON4A(fullfile(outDir, 'ACTUAL_INITIAL_STATIC_SOURCE_V4A_ACTUAL.json'), report);
end


function [q, receipt] = closeLanding(C, G, names, initial, act, target)
fixed = act(1:4);
dependent = [];
for j = 1:30
    child = C.joints.(names{j}).child;
    if ~ismember(j, fixed) && ~startsWith(names{j}, 'guide_roller_') && ~ismember(child, {'left_wheel', 'right_wheel'})
        dependent(end+1) = j; %#ok<AGROW>
    end
end
assert(numel(dependent) == 16, 'Own16 dependent passive/mimic coordinates expected.');
q = initial; q(fixed) = target;
lb = -inf(16, 1); ub = inf(16, 1);
for j = 1:16
    lim = C.joints.(names{dependent(j)}).limits_si;
    if ~isempty(lim), lb(j) = lim(1); ub(j) = lim(2); end
end
x0 = q(dependent);
assert(all(x0 >= lb & x0 <= ub), 'Initial guess is outside real authored bounds; do not silently clamp.');
before = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
options = optimoptions('fmincon', 'Display', 'off', 'Algorithm', 'sqp', ...
    'MaxIterations', 200, 'MaxFunctionEvaluations', 6000, 'FunctionTolerance', 1e-14, ...
    'OptimalityTolerance', 1e-10, 'StepTolerance', 1e-12);
objective = @(x) landingObjective(C, G, names, q, dependent, x);
[x, value, flag, solver] = fmincon(objective, x0, [], [], [], [], lb, ub, [], options);
q(dependent) = x;
after = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
receipt = struct('dependent_names', {names(dependent)}, 'fixed_motor_names', {names(fixed)}, ...
    'fixed_motor_target4', target, 'initial_anchor_max_m', before.closure_max_m, ...
    'solved_anchor_max_m', after.closure_max_m, 'mimic_residual', after.mimic_residual, ...
    'exitflag', flag, 'objective', value, 'solver', solver, ...
    'is_passive_interpolation_claimed_closed', false, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
assert(after.closure_max_m <= .002 && max(abs(after.mimic_residual)) < 1e-6, 'Landing IK did not produce a closed offline pose.');
end

function value = landingObjective(C, G, names, q, dependent, x)
q(dependent) = x;
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
value = sum((1000*g.constraint_vector).^2);
end

function [angles, receipt] = alignCOM(C, G, names, q)
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q);
points = wheelSupportPoints(G, g.body_names, g.body_position, g.body_rotation);
delta = g.COM-mean(points, 2);
initial = [atan2(-delta(1), delta(3)); 0];
assert(abs(initial(1)) <= .6, 'COM balance initial pitch outside declared offline search range.');
options = optimoptions('fmincon', 'Display', 'off', 'Algorithm', 'sqp', ...
    'MaxIterations', 120, 'MaxFunctionEvaluations', 1200, 'FunctionTolerance', 1e-16, ...
    'OptimalityTolerance', 1e-10, 'StepTolerance', 1e-12);
objective = @(a) alignmentObjective(C, G, names, q, a);
[angles, value, flag, solver] = fmincon(objective, initial, [], [], [], [], [-.6; -.3], [.6; .3], [], options);
[~, errors] = alignmentObjective(C, G, names, q, angles);
receipt = struct('base_pitch_roll_rad', angles, 'initial_pitch_roll_rad', initial, ...
    'offline_search_bounds_pitch_roll_rad', [-.6, .6; -.3, .3], ...
    'search_bounds_are_not_actual_robot_limits', true, 'residual_COM_line_and_wheel_height_m', errors, ...
    'exitflag', flag, 'objective', value, 'solver', solver, ...
    'geometry_only_not_angular_momentum_or_dynamic_stability', true);
end

function [value, error] = alignmentObjective(C, G, names, q, angles)
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, zeros(3, 1), ry(angles(1))*rx(angles(2)));
points = wheelSupportPoints(G, g.body_names, g.body_position, g.body_rotation);
distance = supportLine(g.COM, points);
error = [distance; points(3, 1)-points(3, 2)];
value = sum((1000*error).^2);
end

function roll = levelRoll(C, G, names, q, pitch)
fun = @(a) wheelHeightDifference(C, G, names, q, pitch, a);
assert(fun(-.3)*fun(.3) <= 0, 'Wheel-level roll is not bracketed in the offline comparison box.');
roll = fzero(fun, [-.3, .3]);
end

function difference = wheelHeightDifference(C, G, names, q, pitch, roll)
g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C, G, names, q, zeros(3, 1), ry(pitch)*rx(roll));
difference = g.wheel_low(3, 1)-g.wheel_low(3, 2);
end

function [distance, fraction] = supportLine(COM, points)
line = points(1:2, 2)-points(1:2, 1);
offset = COM(1:2)-points(1:2, 1);
assert(norm(line) > .1, 'Own two wheel transverse support line required.');
distance = (line(2)*offset(1)-line(1)*offset(2))/norm(line);
fraction = (offset.'*line)/(line.'*line);
end

function solution = staticEffort(C, p, names, q, act, d, J, JC, fixedTorque)
r = size(J, 1); n = 6+r+6;
E = [d.B_action_torque_order6, J.', JC.'];
b = d.h-d.gas_generalized_force;
peak = [C.leg_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(2, 1)];
continuous = [C.leg_motor.continuous_torque_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.continuous_torque_nm*ones(2, 1)];
lb = [-peak; -inf(r+6, 1)]; ub = [peak; inf(r+6, 1)];
if ~isempty(fixedTorque)
    lb(1:6) = fixedTorque; ub(1:6) = fixedTorque;
end
for wheel = 1:2, lb(6+r+(wheel-1)*3+3) = 0; end
A = []; rhs = []; mu = .7;
for wheel = 1:2
    idx = 6+r+(wheel-1)*3+(1:3);
    for sx = [-1, 1]
        for sy = [-1, 1]
            row = zeros(1, n); row(idx) = [sx, sy, -mu];
            A = [A; row]; rhs = [rhs; 0]; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
    end
end
for j = 1:4
    % Position targets may exceed a named JOINT STATE limit intentionally.
    % Only original raw +/-6 and CAD target projection constrain this solve.
    row = zeros(1, n); row(j) = 1/60;
    A = [A; row; -row]; rhs = [rhs; 3-q(act(j)); 3+q(act(j))]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
for j = [1, 3]
    row = zeros(1, n); row(j) = 1/60; row(j+1) = -1/60;
    delta = q(act(j))-q(act(j+1));
    A = [A; row; -row]; rhs = [rhs; p.diff_max-delta; delta-p.diff_min]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
for j = 5:6
    row = zeros(1, n); row(j) = 1/.6;
    A = [A; row; -row]; rhs = [rhs; 60; 60]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
[~, RR, pivot] = qr(E.', 'vector'); diagonal = abs(diag(RR));
eqTolerance = 1e-10*max([diagonal; 1]); eqRank = sum(diagonal > eqTolerance);
selectedEq = pivot(1:eqRank);
H = diag([1./peak.^2; 1e-12*ones(r, 1); 1e-8/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81)^2*ones(6, 1)]);
options = optimoptions('quadprog', 'Display', 'off', 'Algorithm', 'interior-point-convex', ...
    'MaxIterations', 400, 'ConstraintTolerance', 1e-9, 'OptimalityTolerance', 1e-9);
[z, value, flag, solver] = quadprog(H, zeros(n, 1), A, rhs, E(selectedEq, :), b(selectedEq), lb, ub, [], options);
hardFlag = flag; hardSolver = solver; usedSoft = false;
if isempty(z) || flag <= 0 || max(abs(E*z-b)) > 1e-6
    % A bounded least-residual diagnostic is preserved as a failure to prove
    % static equilibrium. It is never relabelled as an equality solution.
    scale = ones(36, 1)/40;
    scale(1:3) = 1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81);
    scale(4:6) = 1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81*.3);
    for j = 1:30
        if strcmp(C.joints.(names{j}).type, 'slide'), scale(6+j) = 1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81); end
    end
    W2 = diag(scale.^2);
    softH = E.'*W2*E+1e-8*H;
    softH = (softH+softH.')/2;
    [z, value, flag, solver] = quadprog(softH, -E.'*W2*b, A, rhs, [], [], lb, ub, [], options);
    usedSoft = true;
end
if isempty(z) || any(~isfinite(z))
    solution = struct('status', 'NO_STATIC_OR_BOUNDED_RESIDUAL_SOLUTION', ...
        'hard_exitflag', hardFlag, 'hard_solver', hardSolver, ...
        'last_exitflag', flag, 'last_solver', solver, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
    return;
end
tau = z(1:6); lambda = z(7:6+r); forces = reshape(z(7+r:end), 3, 2);
residual = E*z-b;
pd = mapTorqueThroughOriginalPD(C, p, q, act, tau);
mappedResidual = d.B_action_torque_order6*pd.actual_torque6_after_nominal_two_signed_clips+J.'*lambda+JC.'*forces(:)-b;
maxConstraintViolation = max([0; A*z-rhs; lb-z; z-ub]);
isEquality = ~usedSoft && flag > 0 && max(abs(residual)) <= 1e-6 ...
    && max(abs(mappedResidual)) <= 1e-6 && maxConstraintViolation <= 1e-6;
status = 'BOUNDED_LEAST_RESIDUAL_NOT_A_STATIC_EQUILIBRIUM_PROOF';
if isEquality, status = 'ALTERNATE_POINT_CONTACT_STATIC_EQUATIONS_SATISFIED_NOT_PHYSX_OR_STABILITY'; end
solution = struct('status', status, 'hard_exitflag', hardFlag, 'hard_solver', hardSolver, ...
    'used_soft_residual_fallback', usedSoft, 'last_exitflag', flag, 'last_solver', solver, ...
    'objective', value, 'tau6_Nm', tau, 'loop_lambda_selected', lambda, ...
    'ground_reaction_world_N', forces, 'mu_assumed_not_measured', mu, ...
    'static_generalized_residual36', residual, 'root_force_residual_N', residual(1:3), ...
    'root_moment_residual_Nm', residual(4:6), 'joint_generalized_residual30', residual(7:36), ...
    'max_mixed_unit_residual', max(abs(residual)), ...
    'all36_residual_after_original_PD_and_clips', mappedResidual, ...
    'static_linear_system_rank', eqRank, 'selected_equality_rows', selectedEq, ...
    'equality_rank_numerical_tolerance', eqTolerance, 'static_matrix_singular_values', svd(E), ...
    'unbounded_nullspace_consistency_residual', b-E*(pinv(E)*b), ...
    'max_inequality_or_bound_violation', maxConstraintViolation, 'peak_effort_limit6_Nm', peak, ...
    'remaining_peak_effort6_Nm', peak-abs(tau), 'continuous_rating6_Nm', continuous, ...
    'within_continuous_rating6', abs(tau) <= continuous, ...
    'continuous_rating_is_not_the_original_runtime_clip', true, ...
    'nominal_PD_target', pd, 'all_velocities_zero', true, ...
    'steady_queue_required_before_claiming_PD_torque', true, ...
    'no_duration_thermal_or_dynamic_stability_proof', true, 'physical_teacher_valid', false);
end

function result = mapTorqueThroughOriginalPD(C, p, q, act, torque)
leg = q(act(1:4))+torque(1:4)/60;
wheel = torque(5:6)/.6;
requestedTarget = [leg; wheel];
rawBefore = [leg/.5; wheel/10];
raw = max(-6, min(6, rawBefore));
processed = [.5*raw(1:4); 10*raw(5:6)];
for j = [1, 3]
    processed(j) = min(processed(j+1)+p.diff_max, max(processed(j+1)+p.diff_min, processed(j)));
end
requested = [60*(processed(1:4)-q(act(1:4))); .6*processed(5:6)];
limit = [C.leg_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(2, 1)];
stall = [C.leg_motor.envelope_intercept_nm*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.envelope_intercept_nm*ones(2, 1)];
speed = [C.leg_motor.no_load_speed_rpm*2*pi/60*ones(4, 1); C.wheel_motor.no_load_speed_rpm*2*pi/60*ones(2, 1)];
[first, clip1] = dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1(requested, zeros(6, 1), limit, stall, speed);
[actual, clip2] = dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1(first, zeros(6, 1), limit, stall, speed);
outside = [];
for j = 1:4
    limits = C.joints.(pActionName(j)).limits_si;
    if processed(j) < limits(1) || processed(j) > limits(2), outside(end+1) = j; end %#ok<AGROW>
end
result = struct('requested_equivalent_torque6_Nm', torque, 'qtarget_equals_q_plus_tau_over_kp4', requestedTarget(1:4), ...
    'wheel_velocity_target2_rad_s', wheel, 'raw6_before_original_clip', rawBefore, ...
    'raw6_after_original_clip', raw, 'processed_target6_after_CAD', processed, ...
    'actual_torque6_after_nominal_two_signed_clips', actual, 'actual_minus_equivalent_torque6', actual-torque, ...
    'nominal_episode_step_scales6', ones(6, 1), 'two_clip_origin_captured210_not72_runtime_equivalence', true, ...
    'first_clip', clip1, 'second_clip', clip2, 'target_outside_named_q_domain_indices', outside, ...
    'target_outside_named_q_domain_is_not_actual_q_limit_violation', true, ...
    'deliberate_PD_saturation_is_possible_and_must_be_reported', true, ...
    'state_not_clamped_or_modified', true, 'no_external_force', true);
end

function name = pActionName(j)
names = {'left_crank', 'left_hip', 'right_crank', 'right_hip'};
name = names{j};
end

function domain = actualQDomain(C, names, q, act)
violations = struct('joint', {}, 'q', {}, 'limits', {});
for j = 1:30
    lim = C.joints.(names{j}).limits_si;
    if ~isfinite(q(j)) || (~isempty(lim) && (q(j) < lim(1) || q(j) > lim(2)))
        violations(end+1) = struct('joint', names{j}, 'q', q(j), 'limits', lim); %#ok<AGROW>
    end
end
cad = [];
for j = [1, 3]
    delta = q(act(j))-q(act(j+1));
    if delta < -1.0843 || delta > .85, cad(end+1) = j; end %#ok<AGROW>
end
domain = struct('actual_q30_violations', violations, 'actual_CAD_violations', cad, ...
    'no_actual_state_clamp', true, 'actual_q_and_PD_target_domains_are_distinct', true);
end

function [points, JC] = contactsAndJ(G, d)
names = cellstr(string(G.body_names));
points = wheelSupportPoints(G, names, d.body_position, d.body_rotation);
JC = zeros(6, 36);
for j = 1:2
    wheels = {'left_wheel', 'right_wheel'};
    b = find(strcmp(names, wheels{j}), 1);
    offset = points(:, j)-d.body_position(:, b);
    JC((j-1)*3+(1:3), :) = d.body_origin_Jv(:, :, b)-skew(offset)*d.body_Jw(:, :, b);
end
end

function points = wheelSupportPoints(G, bodyNames, P, R)
shapes = G.shapes; if isstruct(shapes), shapes = num2cell(shapes); end
wheelNames = {'left_wheel', 'right_wheel'};
points = zeros(3, 2);
for j = 1:2
    b = find(strcmp(bodyNames, wheelNames{j}), 1);
    ix = find(cellfun(@(s) strcmp(s.body, wheelNames{j}), shapes));
    assert(numel(ix) == 1 && strcmp(shapes{ix}.type, 'Mesh'), 'Own exact single wheel mesh required.');
    shape = shapes{ix};
    vertices = R(:, :, b)*shape.linear_body_from_shape*shape.points.'+P(:, b)+R(:, :, b)*shape.origin_body_m(:);
    z = min(vertices(3, :));
    points(:, j) = mean(vertices(:, abs(vertices(3, :)-z) < 1e-12), 2);
end
end


function [value, meta] = readJSON4A(path, expected, key)
[bytes, meta] = readPinned4A(path, expected, key);
value = jsondecode(native2unicode(bytes(:).', 'UTF-8'));
end
function [bytes, meta] = readPinned4A(path, expected, key)
fid = fopen(path, 'rb'); assert(fid >= 0); cleanup = onCleanup(@() fclose(fid)); %#ok<NASGU>
bytes = fread(fid, Inf, '*uint8'); md = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256');
md.update(typecast(uint8(bytes(:)), 'int8'));
sha = lower(reshape(dec2hex(typecast(md.digest(), 'uint8'), 2).', 1, []));
assert(strcmpi(sha, expected), ['Source/input SHA mismatch: ', key]);
meta = struct('key', key, 'path', path, 'bytes', numel(bytes), 'sha256', sha, 'read_count', 1);
end
function same = samePath4A(a, b)
same = strcmpi(strrep(a, '\', '/'), strrep(b, '\', '/'));
end
function writeNewJSON4A(path, value)
assert(~isfile(path) && ~isfolder(path)); fid = fopen(path, 'wb'); assert(fid >= 0);
cleanup = onCleanup(@() fclose(fid)); %#ok<NASGU>

assert(fwrite(fid, bytes, 'uint8') == numel(bytes));
end
function R = rx(a)
R = [1, 0, 0; 0, cos(a), -sin(a); 0, sin(a), cos(a)];
end
function R = ry(a)
R = [cos(a), 0, sin(a); 0, 1, 0; -sin(a), 0, cos(a)];
end
function R = rz4A(a)
R = [cos(a), -sin(a), 0; sin(a), cos(a), 0; 0, 0, 1];
end
function R = qmat4A(q)
q = q(:)/norm(q); w = q(1); x = q(2); y = q(3); z = q(4);
R = [1-2*(y*y+z*z), 2*(x*y-w*z), 2*(x*z+w*y); ...
     2*(x*y+w*z), 1-2*(x*x+z*z), 2*(y*z-w*x); ...
     2*(x*z-w*y), 2*(y*z+w*x), 1-2*(x*x+y*y)];
end
function S = skew(v)
S = [0, -v(3), v(2); v(3), 0, -v(1); -v(2), v(1), 0];
end

        require(verified_parameter_source_sha256==PARAMETER_SHA,'Current original140V2 parameter source must remain exact')
        require(verified_helper_source_sha256==HELPER_SHA,'ROOT must load exact frozen V2 helper source')

        require(bindings['static_report']['sha256']==MATH_SHA and bindings['static_report']['producer_pid']==71796,'Actual ROOT mathematical source provenance')

        require(bindings['frozen_feedback_module']['sha256']==HELPER_SHA,'Actual helper provenance')

        require(self.parameters.velocity_integral_gain_rad_per_m_s==0 and self.parameters.integral_omega_limit_rad_s==0,'This bound candidate keeps integral disabled')

"""DRAFT ground-hold reference structure; no deployment or static bindings.

Pure source candidate for ROOT's zero-PT teacher case. No files, SDK, model,
RNG, forces, reset or environment state APIs. The original phase controller
must still run once; this helper returns its raw6 unchanged when ineligible.
Actual static references and all new runtime purposes remain ROOT-owned.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass
import math

GROUND_HOLD_PHASES = frozenset(('SETTLE', 'STABILIZE', 'SUCCESS_HOLD'))
ACTION4 = ('left_crank', 'left_hip', 'right_crank', 'right_hip')
Q_DOMAIN4 = ((-1.2, .9), (-.5, .5), (-1.2, .9), (-.5, .5))


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def finite(values):
    return all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in values)


def actual_bool(value, name):
    require(type(value) is bool, 'Plain cached actual Python bool required: '+name)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StaticGroundReferenceV2:
    reference_id: str
    q_reference4: tuple
    pitch_equilibrium_rad: float
    roll_equilibrium_rad: float
    static_torque6_Nm: tuple
    source_result_sha256: str
    source_static_equations_verified: bool
    kind: str = 'ROOT_ACTUAL_STATIC_SOURCE_RESULT'

    def __post_init__(self):
        q = tuple(map(float, self.q_reference4))
        tau = tuple(map(float, self.static_torque6_Nm))
        require(len(q) == 4 and len(tau) == 6, 'Original named4 and torque6 required')
        require(finite(q+tau+(self.pitch_equilibrium_rad,self.roll_equilibrium_rad)), 'Finite static reference required')
        require(all(lo <= x <= hi for x,(lo,hi) in zip(q,Q_DOMAIN4)), 'Source reference q outside authored domain; do not clamp')
        require(all(-1.0843 <= q[i]-q[i+1] <= .85 for i in (0,2)), 'Source reference q outside original CAD domain')
        require(len(self.source_result_sha256) == 64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in self.source_result_sha256.lower()), 'Exact producer result SHA required')
        require(self.kind in ('ROOT_ACTUAL_STATIC_SOURCE_RESULT','SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY'), 'Typed source-reference kind required')
        actual_bool(self.source_static_equations_verified, 'source_static_equations_verified')
        require(self.source_static_equations_verified, 'Soft residual/fallback/unverified result is not a static reference')
        object.__setattr__(self,'q_reference4',q)
        object.__setattr__(self,'static_torque6_Nm',tau)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GroundFeedbackParametersV2:
    wheel_forward_gain2_m: tuple
    wheel_pitch_gain: float
    wheel_pitch_rate_gain: float
    speed_error_gain: float
    yaw_gain: float = 2.
    yaw_rate_gain: float = .5
    lateral_gain: float = .5
    roll_leg_gain: float = .15
    roll_leg_rate_gain: float = .03
    track_m: float = .4376
    wheel_radius_m: float = .0625
    leg_kp: float = 60.
    leg_kd: float = 2.
    wheel_kd: float = .6
    velocity_integral_gain_rad_per_m_s: float = 0.
    integral_omega_limit_rad_s: float = 0.

    def __post_init__(self):
        gains=tuple(map(float,self.wheel_forward_gain2_m))
        require(len(gains)==2 and finite(gains) and all(abs(x)>1e-5 for x in gains), 'Verified signed own wheel gains required')
        scalars=tuple(v for k,v in self.__dict__.items() if k!='wheel_forward_gain2_m')
        require(finite(scalars), 'Finite source controller parameters required')
        require(self.leg_kp==60. and self.leg_kd==2. and self.wheel_kd==.6 and self.wheel_radius_m==.0625, 'Original nominal PD/scales only')
        require(self.velocity_integral_gain_rad_per_m_s>=0 and self.integral_omega_limit_rad_s>=0, 'Nonnegative declared integral parameters required')
        require(self.velocity_integral_gain_rad_per_m_s==0 or self.integral_omega_limit_rad_s>0, 'Enabled integral requires an explicit finite cap')
        object.__setattr__(self,'wheel_forward_gain2_m',gains)


class GroundReferenceFeedbackV2:
    """Scalar causal state only. It never resets or modifies a plant state.

    Original core decision/clock is provided once per100Hz decision. Default
    Ki0 leaves the integral disabled; enabling it needs a separate ROOT-bound
    parameter/trial purpose. Saturation UNKNOWN freezes its accumulation.
    """
    def __init__(self, parameters):
        self.p=parameters
        self.episode_id=None
        self.last_control=None
        self.integral_omega=0.

    def _map(self, reference, o, desired_vx, integral):
        p=self.p
        qref=reference.q_reference4
        tau=reference.static_torque6_Nm
        roll_error=o['root_roll']-reference.roll_equilibrium_rad
        correction=p.roll_leg_gain*roll_error+p.roll_leg_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][0]
        leg=[q+t/p.leg_kp+d for q,t,d in zip(qref,tau[:4],(correction,-correction,-correction,correction))]
        pre_CAD=tuple(leg)
        for i in (0,2):
            leg[i]=min(leg[i+1]+.85,max(leg[i+1]-1.0843,leg[i]))
        vx=o['world_velocity3'][0]
        omega=(vx/p.wheel_radius_m+p.wheel_pitch_gain*(o['root_pitch']-reference.pitch_equilibrium_rad)
            +p.wheel_pitch_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][1]+p.speed_error_gain*(desired_vx-vx)+integral)
        yaw_target=-p.yaw_gain*o['root_yaw']-p.yaw_rate_gain*o['world_angular_velocity3'][2]-p.lateral_gain*o['root_y']
        differential=p.track_m/(2*p.wheel_radius_m)*yaw_target
        wheel=[p.wheel_radius_m*(omega-differential)/p.wheel_forward_gain2_m[0]+tau[4]/p.wheel_kd,
               p.wheel_radius_m*(omega+differential)/p.wheel_forward_gain2_m[1]+tau[5]/p.wheel_kd]
        unclipped=tuple(x/.5 for x in leg)+tuple(x/10 for x in wheel)
        raw=tuple(max(-6.,min(6.,x)) for x in unclipped)
        # Preserve original plant CAD projection AFTER its raw clamp as well.
        processed=[.5*x for x in raw[:4]]+[10.*x for x in raw[4:]]
        for i in (0,2):
            processed[i]=min(processed[i+1]+.85,max(processed[i+1]-1.0843,processed[i]))
        requested_tau=tuple(p.leg_kp*(target-q)-p.leg_kd*dq for target,q,dq in zip(processed[:4],o['actual_q4'],o['actual_dq4']))
        requested_tau+=tuple(p.wheel_kd*(target-dq) for target,dq in zip(processed[4:],o['actual_wheel_dq2']))
        outside=[dict(joint=n,target=x,joint_STATE_domain=[lo,hi]) for n,x,(lo,hi) in zip(ACTION4,processed,Q_DOMAIN4) if x<lo or x>hi]
        qoutside=[dict(joint=n,q=x,joint_STATE_domain=[lo,hi]) for n,x,(lo,hi) in zip(ACTION4,o['actual_q4'],Q_DOMAIN4) if x<lo or x>hi]
        return dict(raw6=raw, unclipped_raw6=unclipped, processed_target6_after_original_CAD=tuple(processed),
            pre_CAD_leg_target4=pre_CAD, nominal_PD_requested_torque6_before_original_clip=requested_tau,
            original_raw_clip_changed=raw!=unclipped, target_outside_joint_STATE_domain=outside,
            actual_q4_outside_source_domain=qoutside, target_domain_and_actual_q_domain_are_distinct=True)

    def step(self, *, observation, original_raw6, phase, reference, reference_is_stationary,
            reference_matches_current_phase_target, actuator_saturation_observed, desired_vx=0.):
        o=observation
        require(type(o['episode_id']) is int and type(o['global_control']) is int, 'Original plain integer identity required')
        require(0<=o['global_control']<2000, 'Original global control cap retained')
        for key in ('original_done','clean_air_now'):
            actual_bool(o[key],key)
        actual_bool(reference_is_stationary,'reference_is_stationary')
        actual_bool(reference_matches_current_phase_target,'reference_matches_current_phase_target')
        require(len(o['wheel_support2'])==2, 'Actual support pair required')
        for value in o['wheel_support2']:
            actual_bool(value,'wheel_support2')
        require(actuator_saturation_observed is None or type(actuator_saturation_observed) is bool, 'Saturation must be actual bool or UNKNOWN None')
        shapes={'world_velocity3':3,'world_angular_velocity3':3,'actual_q4':4,'actual_dq4':4,'actual_wheel_dq2':2}
        for key,n in shapes.items():
            require(len(o[key])==n and finite(o[key]), 'Finite existing buffer required: '+key)
        require(finite(tuple(o[k] for k in ('root_pitch','root_roll','root_yaw','root_y'))+(desired_vx,)), 'Finite actual root/reference values required')
        original=tuple(map(float,original_raw6))
        require(len(original)==6 and finite(original) and all(abs(x)<=6. for x in original), 'Original emitted raw6 required for passthrough')
        if self.last_control is not None:
            require(o['global_control']==self.last_control+1, 'One causal step per original decision; no replay/skipped clock')
        new_episode=self.episode_id!=o['episode_id']
        if new_episode:
            self.integral_omega=0.
            self.episode_id=o['episode_id']
        self.last_control=o['global_control']
        reset_reason=None
        if o['original_done']:
            self.integral_omega=0.;reset_reason='ORIGINAL_DONE'
        elif o['clean_air_now']:
            self.integral_omega=0.;reset_reason='ORIGINAL_TRUE_AIR'
        eligible=(phase in GROUND_HOLD_PHASES and not o['original_done'] and not o['clean_air_now']
            and all(o['wheel_support2']) and reference_is_stationary and reference_matches_current_phase_target)
        if not eligible:
            return dict(raw6=original, ground_patch_applied=False, integral_omega=self.integral_omega,
                integral_status=reset_reason or 'FROZEN_INELIGIBLE', original_decision_passthrough=True,
                physical_teacher_valid=False, no_plant_or_original_goal_guard_write=True)
        require(isinstance(reference,StaticGroundReferenceV2), 'Verified typed ground-static reference required')
        old=self.integral_omega
        p=self.p
        integral_status='DISABLED_KI_ZERO'
        proposed=old
        if p.velocity_integral_gain_rad_per_m_s>0:
            error=desired_vx-o['world_velocity3'][0]
            delta=p.velocity_integral_gain_rad_per_m_s*.01*error
            candidate=max(-p.integral_omega_limit_rad_s,min(p.integral_omega_limit_rad_s,old+delta))
            if actuator_saturation_observed is None:
                integral_status='FROZEN_ACTUATOR_SATURATION_UNKNOWN'
            elif actuator_saturation_observed and abs(candidate)>=abs(old):
                integral_status='FROZEN_OBSERVED_SATURATION'
            else:
                trial=self._map(reference,o,desired_vx,candidate)
                worsening_raw_clip=any((x>6 and candidate>old) or (x< -6 and candidate<old) for x in trial['unclipped_raw6'][4:])
                if worsening_raw_clip:
                    integral_status='FROZEN_WORSENING_ORIGINAL_RAW_CLIP'
                else:
                    proposed=candidate
                    integral_status='UNWINDING_OBSERVED_SATURATION' if actuator_saturation_observed else 'BOUNDED_INTEGRATING'
        self.integral_omega=proposed
        result=self._map(reference,o,desired_vx,proposed)
        result.update(ground_patch_applied=True, reference_id=reference.reference_id,
            reference_kind=reference.kind, reference_result_sha256=reference.source_result_sha256,
            pitch_reference_rad=reference.pitch_equilibrium_rad, roll_reference_rad=reference.roll_equilibrium_rad,
            integral_omega_before=old,integral_omega=proposed,integral_status=integral_status,
            nominal_PD_torque_estimate_is_NOT_measured_or_final_clipped_effort=True,
            physical_teacher_valid=False, runtime_admission=False,
            no_plant_or_original_goal_guard_write=True)
        return result

It establishes that deeper bank targets exist in a conditional source domain and gives their control/geometry tradeoffs. It proves no jump, no adequate impulse and no H32 preparation fix.

The MATLAB source interface accepts ROOT's exact current parameter-file SHA and this candidate artifact SHA, preserving the supplied launch front (ROOT's V2 .14) and original command publisher. The builder reports a205-point nominal target mapping scan, including combined roll correction up to±.06rad, and never silently approves or clamps violations. It has not been run or syntax-checked in MATLAB by this author. ROOT may checkcode/execute it with a new purpose/outDir; it invokes no plant, optimizer, SDK or model itself.
